Review Text:
Absolutely wonderful experience! The flight itself is fantastic, and we loved the sights, the employees are where this tour really shines!

We traveled with our baby son (2.5mo), and Eldridge at the check-in desk was incredible! The check-in and safety orientation process was incredibly easy, and Eldridge was very patient as my wife needed to step away to feed our son ahead of the flight.

We were joined by another young family with a more mobile older child, and both Eldridge and the pilot, Kamaka, were hyper aware of where she was at as well as recommending someone hold her hand as another plane was coming in while we all loaded into our plane to ensure her safety.

As for the flight itself, Kamaka was an amazing pilot and guid! They take passenger weights and plane balancing seriously, and they also do what they can to keep groups together. We were fortunate to have a beautiful day for sightseeing, and Kamaka even helped us spot a pod of dolphins as well as a couple different whales breaching.

For young families, this is the tour to do, and while we brought our little guy his own hearing protection, it sounded like they had some available as well.

We were debating between a plane and helicopter, and ended up going with the plane due to general safety considerations. We were a bit worried about the view from the plane vs a helicopter, but the windows on the plane were great, and Kamaka did a great job ensuring everyone had an equal opportunity for viewing everything.

10/10 would do again in a heartbeat when we’re back (hopefully soon!), and this will be our top recommendation to family and friends visiting Kauai going forward!

Thank you Eldridge and Kamaka!!

Review Title: Not to be missed experience on Kauai!
Review Text:
WOW! Just WOW! Our flight with Wings Over Kauai is one of the activities I was most looking forward to on our trip, and it totally delivered! It was truly the most magical and breathtaking experience of my life.

I know there are many options for seeing Kauai by air, including both helicopters and small airplanes, but let me convince you that Wings Over Kauai is the way to go.

1) The tour lasts about 1 hour and allows you to see more of the island that the helicopters, which usually skip the south shore on their flights.
2) There are no middle seats! This guarantees that everyone on the plane will get a window seat, and if the plane isn't at full capacity (our plane was max 6 passengers), then everyone is seated on the right which is the best view on the tour.
3) The cost is about half the cost of the helicopters. Let me repeat that, it costs about half of what the helicopters charge!
4) They have GoPro cameras attached to each wing and one inside the plane which record the flight. You can purchase an edited video of your actual flight which is 100% worth it IMO!
5) Our pilot was Marcus and he was absolutely fantastic! He is a birder, like my sister, and before our flight he even wrote down tips on where to see birds on the island. He did an incredible job narrating throughout our flight, and the flight itself was incredibly smooth and comfortable. Marcus truly went above and beyond and made our experience even better than I could have imagined.
6) If you are prone to motion sickness, often times the small planes can provide a smoother flight with less rapid changes in motion than helicopters.
7) I actually prefer that the plane flies a bit higher and provides a better panorama and wider shots than helicopters that fly closer to the terrain. If you have a camera with a good zoom lens, you can still get really nice close up shots!
8) Did I mention it's about half the price of the helicopters?

Review Title: Great Value; Great Service, Great Tour
Review Text: My wife and I appreciated this flight around Kauai.  But, we have to commend the customer care we were shown by the whole staff at Wings over Kauai.  The day we were scheduled to fly, the island was clouded in; they gave us the option of a refund or rebooking.  We gladly rebooked with them for the next day; and instead of the larger group flight we had booked, the provided deluxe two passenger flight piloted by the owner.  We were able to see the parts of the island we wanted to see, but for safety reasons we did not go into the cloudy interior.   We flew at a leisurely pace--slower than a helicopter; this allowed us to see everything close up--allowing time for photos, and getting lots of information from the pilot. He not only explained the islands geography and current history but also pointed out the spots where a number of movies had been made--including Pirates of the Caribbean, Jurrassic Park, and Gilligan's Island.  At half the cost of a helicopter ride and with customer satisfaction and customer safety as their first priorities, we highly recommend this often overlooked option for seeing Kauai from the air.

Review Title: Great tour, beautiful views, best value
Review Text: My sister-in-law is visiting Kauai for a week, and it is her first time here.  Although we are taking her to many of the beaches and beautiful spots on Kauai; to put it all in perspective, I thought about taking her on a helicopter ride.  It had been a few years since I last toured Kauai by helicopter and had not realized how much more expensive, they now are then I remember.  My wife found online Wings Over Kauai Air Tour, and suggested I research.  I reviewed how much they cost for how much time in the air, and I think Wings Over Kauai is half the cost of a comparable helicopter air tour.   So, we booked an afternoon tour in their Air Van.  Huge windows, comfortable seats, and so much quieter than the helicopter tour my wife and I had earlier this year over the Big Island.  I got to sit in the co-pilot seat, my wife and sister-in law were in the row directly behind the pilot and me; there was a 4th passenger directly behind my wife.  Turns out the 4th passenger works for the Hawaii State Parks on Kauai, and he was treating himself to seeing some of what he can never see from the ground.  We lucked out with the weather, and had perfect visibility, and saw so much of the beauty of Kauai, many canyons and waterfalls that can only be seen by air.  The pilot was great, he was also very informative.  Our check-in process was flawless, and I was surprised that there were no upcharges for everyone getting a great view (seat) and perfect opportunities to take lots of pictures.  It was a super blast to sit in the co-pilot’s seat, I just had to remember that I had front and left windows to look through in addition to the large right window at my side.  I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai as a top activity to book while visiting Kauai and for residents too; you will love this.

Review Title: Jaw-dropping visual delight! Safe, calm and professional experience, all at half the price of a helicopter ride!
Review Text:
As a private pilot myself, I can testify that Bruce and Ellen provide an A-grade experience, with a strong foundation in safety and proper aviation protocols.

Bruce gave us a detailed flight briefing for the Australian-made AirVan, which is a robust and spacious airplane. After a smooth takeoff, helped by a headwind, he took us on a lovely flight around Kuaui covering all the high points of this jewel of an island.

We flew over the Pacific Ocean alongside the beautiful beaches of South Kuaui then turned inland to see the awesomeness of the Waimea Canyon. Then we were over the NāPali coast on the north side, appreciating the amazing rock formations winding down like spines into the ocean. After that, we turned inland again, this time to the south, and made our way back to Lihue just above the tall peaks of the highlands.

All in all, an excellent experience, made sweeter by the knowledge that this trip was less than half the cost of a similar helicopter excursion!

Thanks Bruce and Ellen for a great time, and also for the amazing fruit :-)!

Review Title: Best way to see the island!
Review Text:
We did an Airvan tour with Bruce, the founder, as our pilot. He was incredibly knowledgeable (hes a Ph.D. in addition to being a pilot), funny and accommodating to our party of five, several of whom were non-native English speakers. Bruce took us on a circular tour of the island describing various rock formations, plantations, waterfalls and other points of interest. He kept up the witty banter, asked us questions about us lives, and described the general functioning of the airplane and process by which it flies. As you'd expect, he flew smoothly, avoided low clouds and strove to make the flight as comfortable as possible for those on the plane sensitive to bumps.

In addition to the tour itself, which was amazing, Bruce described the aircraft to us and he let me assist with the pre-flight checklist, which I found to be awesome. If you're an aviation nerd, definitely ask to be in the co-pilot seat.

At the conclusion of the tour, Val came over and provided us with a CD of Bruce's favorite Hawaiian music. What was cool was the photo on the cover of the CD -- it was our family picture taken prior to our flight. A really neat and personal touch and something that we really cherish from our trip. We now drive around at home with Bruce's favorite Hawaiian music playing in the car and we think of the amazing time we had in Kauai.

Many thanks Bruce, Val and Wings Over Kauai team!

Review Title: Best way to see Kauai's beauty!
Review Text:
Full disclosure- I suffer from motion sickness fairly easily. I've tried boat rides on calm waters, which end badly for me, so I knew touring the Na Pali coast via raft or helicopter were not options. After extensive researching, I finally decided to try Wings Over Kauai. They advertised their Airvan plane as like riding a bus. This would probably be the best/only option for seeing a glimpse Kauai's awesome landscape.

Booking the trip was very easy. The price per couple was totally reasonable. Checking in for the flight was also easy. Val checked us in and took us into the back room where she went over the safety briefing and let us know what to expect on the tour. Marcus, our pilot, as also in the office checking the weather conditions.

After our final weigh in- we went to the tarmac where Val took a couple pictures of the groups in front of the plane. We donned our life jacket pouches and head sets and waited for take off.

Our pilot, Marcus, was amazing. Super friendly and knowledgeable about the island. He also was a great DJ, queuing up music appropriate for what we were seeing (Jurassic Park Theme when flying over the Jurassic Park waterfall). The views are breathtaking. Our Airvan plane had huge windows so nothing was ever obstructed. The entire flight was a little over an hour and did a tour of pretty much the entire island.

Unfortunately I did end up getting sick towards the end of the tour, though it was entirely my fault. The plane ride itself was smooth, except for the small bump here and there. Val warned us motion sickness sufferers to not take too many pictures out of the window. I did not follow this advice- the beauty was too tempting! Thankfully on board they supply a small cooler filled with ginger candies and water. I would definitely still do this tour over again and will have no problem recommending this activity for other Kauai visitors!

Val, the office manager, and Cameron, the pilot, were both incredibly professional and friendly with us. They made us feel welcome and at ease, and got us settled onto the Cessna with no hiccups. The flight was amazing! Totally worth doing, and a definite highlight of our trip. My 2 1/2 year old enjoyed wearing her headset and looking out of her window for about half the flight, and then had a nap for the rest of the flight.

I would recommend Wings over Kauai for any group. The Cessna is amazing because you get the plane to yourself if you only have a couple and maybe a child. I’m sure the larger plane is great for bigger groups, but I didn’t experience it. Hands down, take this tour!

Review Title: Awesome way to view a beautiful island - Kauai
Review Text: The tour starts with a safety check on the ground, a weigh-in to properly balance the load on the plane, and an overview of the flight plan.  Very organized nd professional.  Then comes the exciting part. Cameron, our pilot, was very knowledgeable and friendly.  From the unbelievably smooth take-off to the same smooth landing, the flight was an amazing experience.  Cameron explained the history of the island people, the island’s eco-system, changes to the land based on decisions made by people, local businesses and and the most beautiful beaches, waterfalls, Waimea Canyon, and, of course, the breathtaking Na Pali coast.  We saw mountains covered in mist, old volcanos, people kayaking on rivers, and did I mention the beautiful waterfalls?  There is no way to see the real beauty of the island, like we did, except by air.  Cameron exceeded our expectations, sometimes doubling back to show us a sight a second time, if we didn’t get a good view the first time.  I would definitely recommend this tour for everyone!

Review Title: Best way for Kauai aerial sightseeing
Review Text: Wings Over Kauai is simply awesome. From the friendly and fast booking experience, to the easy check-in at the airport and culminating with Captain Bruce's flying expertise and knowledge of the Kauai island, this was one of the highlights of our vacation. The caliber of the sights cannot be put into words. It's a largely untamed island, yet where the coastal communities are, the beauty of nature is still preserved. Viewing the Waimea Canyon as well as the monumental Na Pali Coast from above is an epiphany. The airplane windows are perfect for taking non-stop photographs as well as for actually enjoying the landscape with one's own eyes. The tour is over an hour long, it doesn't feel rushed, and while the airplane cannot get as close to a waterfall as a helicopter can, we got the epic scale picture. Definitely would choose this company over any shiny helipcopter tour.

Review Text:
My partner booked this flight tour as he originally wanted a flight with an instructor (he’s a qualified pilot) but these were fully booked. This turned out to work in our favour as it meant that he got to see so much more without having to concentrate on flying.
Our pilot was Bruce and he was an excellent tour guide in the four-seater Cessna. He was funny and warm and pointed out loads of interesting sights, including a shoal of fish in a bay, and various movie locations. When I mentioned that I liked Jurassic Park he made a point of showing us filming locations and even played the soundtrack at one point, which made us laugh. He’s also a very interesting person, and we enjoyed chatting with him throughout our flight.
I was worried that I would maybe get travel sick on the flight as I sometimes do when my partner’s flying but I was absolutely fine, thanks to flying in the morning when it was cooler. Snacks and drinks were provided but neither of us had any as we were so engrossed in the tour.
We were lucky with perfect blue skies and calm conditions and I actually felt like staying on the plane and doing the tour all over again, it was that good!
This really was a highlight of our trip, and we’d highly recommend it.

Review Title: Nice Trips by Wings Over Kauai
Review Text:
At last week of December 2018, we visited Kauai. We planned to view Kauai from sky during our trip. So, we booked “Wings Over Kauai” air plane trip. One of the purpose to select air trip is to view Na Pali coast of Kauai easily, which can be reached by two days trekking or by availing boat. We select Wings Over Kauai air plane trip instead of helicopter. Because, as far my idea goes, helicopter fly closely to the objects like hills and waterfalls. But, in this manner over all view will not available. Another important reason was in helicopter trip window seat is not guaranteed. Almost 50% of passenger will not get window seat. In my idea view will be much restricted if window seat is not available. But, air plane which is used by Wings Over Kauai is a six seaters plane and every seat have a big window.
We booked our trip on December 27, 2018. They prefer that customer should arrive half an hour before start time of flight. Though we were arrived in time other group of our flight became late due to traffic jam on road. But, the company wait for those tourist until they arrived, delaying departure of the flight (Though flight can be departed without those customers, and there was no chance of any loss of the company). It indicates they also care for their customers and not only the money.
Pilot of that flight was Mr. Bruce who was a very nice person and guided us very nicely throughout our tour. Weather was clear and our views from the aircraft was excellent. Mr. Bruce inform us continuously about the location over where the air crafts were flying. We enjoyed that tour very much. We noticed one thing that views are better from the windows other side of pilot seat. Due to orientation of the route followed by the air plane. Though sometimes Mr. Bruce rotate the air plane such that everyone could get the best views. Time of the flight was about one hour. We enjoyed our tour very much. If we plan to visit Kauai, we will avail this tour again.
Disclaimer: This review is the subjective opinion of a Tripadvisor member and not of Tripadvisor LLC.

Review Title: This is how you should see Kauai
Review Text: What a wonderful way to see the island! We took the private 2-person tour on the Cessna and were treated like family. Capt. Bruce (he’s also Dr. Bruce, a retired research scientist!) and Val were very professional and took good care of us. We were unsure of this morning’s trip as the weather forecast was not looking good. Rain and clouds were about to roll in when we got to the airport. Val greeted us cheerfully, checked us in and went through the safety briefing with us thoroughly. I immediately knew that they took safety seriously. We then waited as we were early for our scheduled departure. It started to rain shortly thereafter and Bruce then called us into the office and showed us the big rain clouds over the Lihue & Hanalei area on the computer. He was very honest and told us that we will likely not have clear views over some areas. So he gave us a choice to reschedule, a refund or to go ahead with the tour (assuring us it was safe to do so). What an honest and professional business! We decided to go ahead and was prepared for a less than stellar experience. Boy, were we wrong! While it was cloudy, the sights were still wonderful as Bruce expertly navigated through the clouds and showed us the spectacular Na Pali Coast and the breathtaking Waimea Canyon. We had to turn around at Hanalei due to the storm clouds (again safety first!) while some other operators decided to go through the area. I knew this as I could hear all the chatter over the radio. A couple others did turn around and followed Bruce’s lead. He must be well respected by the flying community! We made it back to Lihue airport safely with full of wonderful memories. Thank you Bruce for your wonderful sense of humor and knowledge about the island. I enjoyed being your “co-pilot”!

Review Text: We (2 of us) enjoyed a flight with Captain Doug mid-July while visiting Kauai for vacation and celebrating my birthday.  I discovered Wings Over Kauai reading Trip Advisor reviews.  We have been on several helicopters tours- over Oahu, Maui, and the big island as well as a tour in the Caribbean over Antigua.  We’ve always enjoyed being able to capture amazing photographs but considered the negative of helicopter tours being booked with other parties and not knowing what seat assignment you may get.  Flying with Wings Over Kauai, we had the advantage of not having to ride with other parties, he enjoyed sitting up front with Captain Doug, and I enjoyed having the back seat to myself to see and take pictures from both sides.  We were initially hesitant about reviews noting how fly higher than helicopter tours, but we didn’t think there was much difference and it didn’t at all effecting the view or taking pictures.  I think we actually captured better pictures.  We went on a boat tour along NaPali coast line the day prior and would agree with previous reviews that it’s so worth seeing the NaPali coastline by boat and by air.  Even after visiting the canyon, the views are so different flying over the canyon.  I experience motion sickness so I didn’t know if this experience would be different.  I took medication prior flying, ate the ginger chews offered, and thought I did better on this flight than helicopter tours.  The windows are closed so don’t have the breeze coming in the window like the helicopter but there was enough air and coolness that motion sickness wasn’t triggered.  I later too found the ginger chews are sold at the ABC stores.  We have learned from previous tours to wear dark colored clothes so there is no reflection in the windows when taking pictures.  Gina was efficient in checking us in and coordinating preparation for our flight.  We appreciated how in addition to the pictures we captured, Gina took our picture in front of the Cessna before departing, shared the pictures by e-mail, as well as gave us a CD of music during our flight afterward with our picture on the front cover.  During our flight time, a Hawaiian Airlines plane landed and there were many helicopters flying the same route around the island.  Captain Doug did a great job toggling back and forth communicating with the tower while letting us know where and what we were flying over.  He took extra time flying at different angles/circling around waterfalls and points of interest we pointed out.  Many reviews highlight a cost savings booking with Wings Over Kauai.  While this is true, I believe more importantly is having an individual, personalized tour experience.  We have no regrets not booking a helicopter tour and are so glad we stumbled upon learning about Wings Over Kauai through Trip Advisor.

Review Text:
We signed up this morning and were aloft with Bruce, the owner, before 12m. The pre-flight orientation was illuminating. The weigh-in was, as advertised, discreet. All of that was good, but, the flight was better! Bruce has been doing this for fourteen years and it shows. Passing over some agricultural fields, we heard briefly about his former career as a research agronomist. Bruce told about owners of great tracts of land, as well as cleverly mixing in movie references as we saw sites of ‘on location’ filming. Then it got even better as we saw the star of our trip — the geographic beauty of Kaua’i as highlighted by the Waimea canyon and Napali coast. Bruce skillfully navigated to give us excellent views down the canyon and all along the coast. He did this while simultaneously narrating with geological background information as well as news about the current state of road closures and personal vignettes from his thousands of hours of flying various versions of this tour. With his help, we were able to identify our particular resort as well as many more general interest sights.
Overall, this was well worth our time and money!
logistical notes — we were seated both on the starboard side, one with the pilot in the front and one behind. This allowed Bruce to orient the craft so as to always give us both the best view. Also, the front seat adjusted downward so the taller passenger could easily see out the side window.

Review Title: Beautiful way to see the island
Review Text:
Plane vs. Helicopter seems to be a matter of thrill vs. camera shots. In the plane, it seems you can get better camera shots because you are further away from everything, but we saw helicopters underneath us who could go quite close to the waterfalls and craters, etc. I imagine it would be awesome to experience but even more difficult to capture. If money were no issue, I might opt for the helicopter but I have no regrets on our plane experience.
My friend and I booked the slightly larger plane because we wanted the bubble windows for better visibility. Unfortunately because there were not four of us, they called us to switch to the private jet, which I was a bit bummed about due to less window visibility (which they at least admitted) even though they didn't charge extra. Regardless, views were nicer on the side than I was worried we'd get (if you're short, it is hard to see out the front even as co-pilot). Doug was super calm and very friendly, which helps if you get altitude sickness (so do their ginger candies and water). Getting there 30min early seemed unnecessary since they didn't see us til 10 min before, yet again were very friendly. Overall would highly recommend seeing Kauai by air, whatever way it is that best works for you and your schedule/budget.

Review Title: Private Cessna is the only way to fly!
Review Text:
We decided to splurge during our visit to Kauai and booked a private flight on Wings Over Kauai's Cessna 172. It was a bit more expensive than the group flight on the Caravan, but so worth it. Imagine having your own private chauffeured hour to fly around the island!

We were warmly welcomed to the flightline by Val. She took our information and gave us a quick rundown of what to expect during our flight. She also discreetly weighed us
to ensure the weight and balance is set up properly for the flight.

We met Captain Bruce and after introductions were made all around, we all walked out to the plane. So much nicer than boarding a commercial flight. Yeah, the plane was smaller but no one was fighting you for overhead bin space! As an #AvGeek (read "plane nerd!") I called shotgun and my wife was nice enough to indulge me. Bruce also teaches flying, so he took the time to explain flight dynamics and how the airplane respond to different inputs. We both worked the pre-flight takeoff list and after waiting for a Hawaiian Airlines 717 to land and vacate the runway, we were off.

It was a beautiful day for flying. Puffy white clouds dotted the sky and visibility was forever. Mt. Waiʻaleʻale was almost totally visible, which is vary rare! Bruce kept up a running commentary was we overflew Poipu Beach, the Waimea Canyon, the Napali Coast, then across Hanalei Bay and back down towards Lihue. When we were halfway through our flight, my wife commenced the drink service with bottles and cans from the cooler under the back seat!

We were thrilled with our choice of Wings Over Kauai. We highly recommend the private Cessna flight for a group of 2 or 3 people. Even if you take the group flight on the Caravan, seeing the island from the air is a fantastic trip and should be considered a "Must Do!" during your visit to the Kauai.

As their rating at TripAdvisor indicates, this is currently the top Outdoor Activity attraction on the island (April 2018) and I would agree. Review Title: It's #1 on Trip Advisor for a reason!
Review Text:

Like everyone else planning a trip, we spent a lot of time on Trip Advisor looking for the best things to do while on our trip in Kauai. Let's just say the experience we had was much like everybody else, FANTASTIC!

We had spent few days on the island prior to our flight, so being able to see the places we'd been from the air was fantastic. I'd recommend doing the same if possible, the flight means so much more when you have that perspective from the ground.

One small knock, and I do mean small...we were scheduled for a tour in the Air Van at 1pm, which we arrived for as instructed a little before 12:30p. When we went to check in we were advised that due to delays everything was now pushed back one hour. The person that checked us in stated we should have received a call letting us know, however that didn't happen. Luckily for us our hotel wasn't too far from the airpot so we were able to kill the hour sitting by the pool. If we'd been saying a little further north it would have been a bit of a drag with no notice.

At the end of the day it wasn't a huge deal at all, the experience was well worth the additional wait. Do yourself a favor and take a flight with WOK, I'm sure the helicopter tours are great, but this is pretty remarkable.

Review Title: One of the greatest excursions I've ever done!!
Review Text:
One of the greatest excursions I've ever done and probably will ever do! We were visiting Kauai for a few days after Maui, and booked the sightseeing flight tour with Wings Over Kauai as our first stop after we arrived at the airport. I highly recommend planning this as the first thing you do on Kauai, because you get a birds eye view of the entire island before you start exploring it by land. It was truly fascinating to see how diverse the different regions of the island are; lush forests/waterfalls, beautiful coastline beaches & mountainous cliffs.

This is a family run business and they went above and beyond to take such good care of us. Mary and Captain Bruce were some of the kindest people we've ever met, truly care about their customer's experience, and made it clear why they love the island so much. They were extremely knowledgeable about Kauai, both local recommendations and about its rich history.

I was initially a little anxious about flying in a small plane, but felt extremely safe and comfortable with Captain Bruce and the smooth ride from take off to landing. He even gave us clearer views of humpback whales from the air than we got from our whale-watching tour by boat days later. He also pointed out a bunch of different movie set locations and flew low enough for exceptional views of the Waimea Canyon!

My boyfriend is a Jurassic Park fanatic, so watching him in awe of the Jurassic Park waterfall, as the Cap'n played the Jurassic Park theme song in our headsets, was priceless. Extremely worth the price and I'd highly recommend over a helicopter tour, especially for anyone a little anxious about flying.

Travel is my passion and I can safely say this is an excursion on the top of my list and a MUST DO experience. Thanks Wings Over Kauai! We can't wait to come back some day!

Review Text: When my parents and I decided we were going to visit Kauai, we decided we needed to take some sort of aerial tour so that we could see the Na Pali coast clearly. This really concerned my mom, so we decided to try out Wings Over Kauai instead. I'm really glad that we did! Our tour guide/pilot, Doug gave us a great tour of the island, and his narration was really great. While we didn't get as close to a few things as the helicopters do, our tour was longer, smoother, and perfect for what we wanted. It's still a small plane, so don't expect it to feel like a jetliner, but Doug was very aware of my mom's aversion to turbulence and managed it like absolute pro. We also met the owners Bruce and Ellen and they were extremely kind and professional. I've got nothing bad to say about Wings Over Kauai and would absolutely recommend them.
Disclaimer: This review is the subjective opinion of a Tripadvisor member and not of Tripadvisor LLC.

Review Text: Vor 25 Jahren war ich das letzte Mal auf Kaui. Für meinen Geburtstag habe ich mir selbst einen Rundflug über Kaui geschenkt. Best gift ever! Mein Reisekumpan und ich hatten uns für diesen speziellen Tag eine Tour mit dem Airvan angemeldet. Zwei Tage vor der Tour wurde mir leider mitgeteilt, dass das Flugzeug defekt war. Im erstem Augenblick grosse Enttäuschung. Doch alles halb so wild. Das Team von Bruce und Elllen Coulombe war so flexibel, dass wir am gleichen Tag trotzdem fliegen konnten; einfach in der Cessna und nur zu zweit und dem Pilot. Der Tag war gerettet. Und er war fantastisch. Strahlender Nachmittag, gute Sicht, ruhiger Flug. Marcus, unser Pilot ist zwar jung aber sehr erfahren und Instruktor zugleich. Wir würden sehr freundlich empfangen und es ging sehr familiär zu.  Die Maschine machte einen etwas gebrauchten Eindruck aber für diesen 75minütigen Rundflug über Kaui spielte es keine Rolle. Die Sicht, die Geschichten und Anekdoten mit der passenden Musik auf dem Kopfhörer gaben uns Gänsehaut. Hin und da musste ich eine Träne verdrängen. Es war einfach wundervoll. Sachte Landung und vorbei war der Traum, der Wirklichkeit wurde. Ein wahrlich unvergesslicher Tag! Danke Wings Over Kaui! Mahalo nur los. Aloha a hui hou.
Disclaimer: This review is the subjective opinion of a Tripadvisor member and not of Tripadvisor LLC.

Review Text: On our recent Pride of America cruise, we moored at Kauai overnight.  We are Australians, and our travelling friend had privately booked a trip with Wings Over Kauai. To see the Na Pali Coast and Kauai parks and countryside by small plane was an amazing experience.  We have flown by helicopter in Maui on other trips, and this small plane trip  was just as exciting, with great visibility. We are all in our sixties and felt very safe with Marcus. We would highly recommend this trip.

Review Text:
We booked the Air Van for a 1pm flight for 5. Prior to booking, we were torn about whether to pay more for a helicopter tour instead, and did a lot of research. In the end, while I'm sure a helicopter ride would be wonderful, the Air Van was almost half the price (we booked online directly and it 550 off 5 people plus tax which came to a little under 590 - GREAT DEAL!) and everyone in our party had a fantastic time...the scenery is just unbelievable! We also had the whole plane to ourselves and everyone had a window seat, which was amazing.

Check in/safety instructions, and weigh in were smooth. They allow some time to let you take pics by the plane and with the pilot before and after he flight. I took some motion sickness pills but they also had some cool neck towels and ginger ale in the cooler in case anyone felt queasy -they do recommend you look ahead out the window to help relieve any motion sickness.

They also ask if you want a video from the attached GoPro on the wings. You get it sent online and it also includes the actual conversations in the plane from your flight. Forget the price, but believe the video cost was around $40.

We also received a free CD with soundtrack from the flight with a picture of our group in front of the plane.

Overall, it was an amazing experience and would not hesitate to go again or recommend others. Great value!!!!

Review Text: I booked an August 18th flight for my family of 4 on December 10th (8+ months in advance) to coincide with a stop of our cruise ship.  I call the day before to confirm details and I'm told the plane won't be available due to unscheduled maintenance.  I was told that they sent me an email the day before (gee thanks but I don't check my email every day when on vacation - how about trying to call my cell).  I was also told the plane was flying today (on the 17th) but had to have the maintenance done on the 18th; really?  You couldn't do the maintenance early or late in the day or cancel a local guy or someone who would be on island longer than a day instead of the guy who flew 14 hours and took a cruise ship to get to the island and booked 8 months in advance?  Due to learning so late, I wound up hanging out on a local beach; not a disaster but not the trip highlight I had planned.  Given I didn't get the "official" cancelation email until 20 minutes after my phone call, I can't help feel that I was really bumped due to a double booking or a similar situation as the story just didn't ring true to me.

Review Text: Really really loved this - definitely a highlight of our Hawaiian honeymoon! Review Title: So glad we started our visit with Wings Over Kauai!
Review Text: My friend and I scheduled our flight several months in advance online, with no problem whatsoever.  We arrived early for the flight, were greeted and checked in and weighed and then we waited briefly before our pilot, Doug, met us.  He was wonderfully good-natured, and was obviously at ease flying the Cessna jet we were in.  He pointed out all kinds of interesting sites, with history included, and answered every question we had with respect.  He obviously knew Kauai quite well, and imparted this information easily.  We loved every minute of our flight, and would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai with its current staff.  The lady who handled our orientation in the office was absolutely delightful, providing cold water and ginger candy and a flower blossom to us (water and candy was accessible in the plane as well) before the flight, and shared some fruit from a market/store with us when the flight had returned.  We purchased the recording of our flight, which we should receive via email in a few days, for $50, and we may share it with whomever we wish, if we wish.  My friend and I are a bit embarrassed-we did not realize at the time that the flight was being recorded, and are wondering how "dumb" we sound, but we look forward to having the recording to view again as a reminder of the beautiful island of Kauai and the pilot and staff of Wings Over Kauai.  I highly recommend this adventure, especially if you are new to the island and would like a great "overview", especially when you first arrive.

Review Text:
We did a helicopter tour the last time we visited Kauai. Since there is so much to see from the air, I wanted to do an aerial tour again. After reading the great views for Wings Over Kauai, I decided to give the small plane tour a try. Not sure I'll ever do another helicopter tour again, if there is a small plane option.

We opted for the Cessna, and it was just me, my wife and the pilot. Bruce was our pilot and he was fantastic! Great commentary along the way, and his experience flying this tour showed as he charted a perfect path around the island.

The flight seemed so much smoother than the helicopters. And my original concerns about just flying past sights without the ability to hover were unfounded.

Not sure if it is always the case, but when they say 65 minute tour they mean it. Pretty sure we were in the air for the full 65 minutes, though it went by way too fast. No discounting for taxi time, etc. or rounding an hour down to 50 minutes.

At the end of the flight they provided us with a list of Bruce's favorites. Wish we had that at the beginning of our visit as his recommendations were spot-on.

This is the way to see Kauai from the air!

Review Text:
I have a slightly different perspective - I flew with both Bruce and Marcus as part of my ongoing training as a private pilot. They were both fantastic instructors AND fantastic tour guides. I also flew 3 times over three weeks, and during the last 2 flights I also brought my girls (one at a time - only one passenger at a time in the Cessna 172. A bunch of folks can fly in the Airvans). My girls had a GREAT time and I got to be the "pilot" even though I was the student.
Maybe the other tours have great guides, but I have a hard time believing they are better guides than Bruce and Marcus. Bruce has lived on the Island for nearly 30 years, and knows the geology, history, ecology - the best beaches and most importantly, the flying!
Both Marcus and Bruce provided great instruction on situational awareness, the winds aloft and terrain effects, and how to keep passengers calm and enjoying the flight. If you are not an aviator, let me say this - these guys are safety minded, vigilant, experienced, and exercise great flight discipline. I learned a TON flying with them.
THE TOUR: beyond beautiful! On every one of my 3 flights we saw new things, from barking sands, to the Na Pali, to the interior of the island, to the biggest resorts. My girls had an amazing time. I recommend doing this early on in your time on the island, as it gave me a mental map of how varied the terrain was, and quickly formed a list of things to see and do. I can also say that you could even do it twice or more, as a passenger, and get new things every time.
If you are an experienced pilot, or just learning like me, you have to do this! If you already have your PPL, fly right seat, as the flights rotate around the island from south east to northwest (na pali) and you will see much more. I stayed in left seat as I wanted to be consistent with the controls for the time being. Having the freedom to fly on vacation was something new to me, and I plan on doing it in norway, out in Colorado, Florida, etc. It will be hard to top the beauty of this trip - one of the best things I've ever done on vacation. Bruce, Ellen, and Marcus run a great experience. 5/5!

Review Title: No luck getting into the air, but Wings is still the best!
Review Text:
My husband and I were rained or otherwise "bad-weathered" out of every adventure we planned on Kauai. Couldn't hike Kalalau due to the river crossing being flooded.
Couldn't kayak or sail the coast due to 24 ft swells. Never got to fly in the Cessna with Doug due to high winds the first day, and low cloud cover and/or rain the other three times we tried. Luckily, we had booked our flight through Wings over Kauai, and originally booked it for our first full day on the island, which ended up giving us the most shots on goal in terms of chances to reschedule and hopefully get up there. Each time we arrived, Doug walked us through the weather, visibility, turbulence, and gave us the choice of getting up there with the limited visibility/bumpy ride or reschedule. We rescheduled three times, and while it never worked out, we still appreciated the customer service and flexible policies of Wings. Our last chance was the AM before our flight off island, and when it became clear the weather still wasn't going to cooperate, we were promptly issued a refund. One thing both my husband and I noticed was that every time we went to the terminal to try to get into the air, the helicopter tours were still going out. So, my guess is they have a limited refund policy and therefore people opt to take the flight even if you don't see anything and/or it's potentially dangerous. Doug and the rest of Wings were incredibly helpful, friendly, and clearly interested in making sure everyone gets the best and safest experience flying over Kauai. I can't wait to go back to Kauai again to accomplish all the adventures we were denied our first time out, and we will definitely be re-booking our tour with Wings over Kauai! We've already passed on their info to three other people we know are heading to Kauai in the next few months. It's so rare to encounter such amazing customer service in this day and age. We can honestly say Wings was a highlight of our time in Kauai even though we didn't even get to fly!

Review Text:
Wings Over Kauai gets 5 stars in my 4P categories.

We began planning our excursions for this vacation several months ago and decided to use independent third party operators in lieu of the expensive ones offered through the cruise line. For Kauai nothing was booked in advance - not usually a good decision considering all the good tours on the ship were sold out.

Professionalism: Upon arriving in Kauai on 4/15, I decided to call Wings Over Kauai to see if they have any cancellations. Using the local number, I did not reach them on the first try and figured I was out of luck. Immediately after hanging up, I received a call from Ellen, she was very friendly and said they had some openings to accommodate one passenger and I booked a flight on their 8 seater for 11am. I received email confirmation within minutes ... outstanding customer service and I was a happy camper.

Performance: I read many of the Trip Advisor comments and let me tell you they do what is advertised, and more! Ellen picked me up at precisely the right time and shuttled me from the ABC Store to the air terminal. Her daughter Mary took care of the reservation paperwork along wth weigh-in to make sure they balance out the seating. Mary said Marcus was our pilot and he would be arriving shortly, and sure enough, he was just landing from a previous flight. Mary and Marcus escorted the 4 of us to the plane, photos were taken by Mary as a souvenir and she said she'd email them after the flight. I felt like the lucky one with the co-pilot seat (Marcus probably didn't feel as lucky)...guess they needed to put me up there for proper weight distribution. Views were absolutely incredible -- from take off to landing, and it was great to fly over the harbor and see the cruise ship at the pier. Marcus' narration of the landmarks, simply outstanding and his piloting skills phenomenal! Very little turbulence, partly cloudy skies and a very smooth flight allowed for some spectacular photograph. The beautiful island music playing through the headsets was a great touch!

Pride: Upon landing we were greeted by Mary and she helped Marcus with getting us off the plane. Bottled water or ginger ale was offered and it sure was appreciated. Marcus asked us to come inside because he had a parting gift for us. Each of us was presented a CD with the Hawaiian music played on our flight and a color picture that was taken at the beginning of the flight as the jewel case cover. It was no charge! A simple gesture that goes a long way in my book, and the kind of thing that will bring me back to them the next time I visit Kauai.

Price: I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai should you want to take advantage of the spectacular Pali Coast scenery not viewable by land. Their price is cheaper than several others I checked out, so please call the (808) local number to discuss your adventure of a lifetime.

I have taken many, many excursions through various cruise lines and bar none, this was the best ever in my opinion. Many thanks to Ellen, Mary and Marcus - and Mary, thank you for bringing me all the way back to the terminal.

Review Title: Great Flight Experience for Pilots Visiting Kauai!
Review Text:
If you get a chance to visit Kauai and get the bug to go fly, please check out Wings over Kauai. They offer fixed wing tours of the island in their C-172 or G8 Airvan. Many areas of this island are not accessible by car and can best be seen from the air.
You can simply ride along, look out the windows, or be PIC (in the 172) with CFI-PHD Bruce Coulombe. He has accumulated 7,000 of his 17,000 hours flying around the island and he knows all the good spots to see.

We spent a little over an hour with Dr. Bruce and truly enjoyed the trip. Kauai is not that big. You can cruise along the tour route in the 172 and see everything in about an hour. Tours are operated out of Lihue airport (PHLI) which is class D. The tours are done under VFR. Considerable effort is expended to avoid the extensive air tour traffic by reporting positions at known checkpoints. Tours are also conducted with great sensitivity to minimizing noise to residents as there are extensive helicopter air tours of the island.
Our C-172 experience was 1/2 the price of a rotary wing tour. We got to see some spectacular scenery and it was a bonus to have 1.1 in the logbook as PIC in Kauai. We highly recommend Wings over Kauai.

Review Text: My two sisters and I planned a lovely, activity filled Christmas in Kauai. We picked this company for our air tour because of the great reviews. Although the flight was nice (Marcus was our pilot) I must comment on the reception and behavior we encountered from Bruce and Abi. We arrived early to an empty lobby area, well over the 30 minutes you are instructed to arrive. We could see out the back windows to the tarmac and noticed that one of the company's planes had just landed. It was the smaller 4-seater plane; a couple had since arrived and told us they had a two o'clock flight. They ended up leaving without taking their flight tour after a conversation with Bruce. We knew another couple was with us which meant that we would be in the larger 6-seater plane at 2:30. I watched a lady (whom I now know as Abi) placing blocks under the wheels of the plane and the pilot climb out of the plane then I moved away from the window further into the lobby to talk to one of my sisters. As we stood talking, the pilot (whom I now know as Bruce) came in through the door and saw us standing there. The expression on his face was not only off-putting, his actions were the same. He didn't speak or say hello at all, just paused scowled and kept walking. In fact, his demeanor was such that both my sister and I looked at each other in askance. As African-Americans we are the both of us very aware, observant and sensitive to our surroundings and peoples' energy. I was glad that he was NOT our pilot. Later as Abi was explaining emergency in-flight procedures to us, correction, to my two sisters; it was as if I didn't exist. She didn't bother to look at me or include me in that conversation. I am 6 feet tall but I was standing directly behind them in a little huddle. It was incredibly rude and disrespectful of her to treat me in such a manner and I let her know. Later there was an issue of seating arrangements in the plane which I think could have been handled differently. I have extremely long legs and was put in a middle seat when the back row seat by the door had no middle seat in front of it. I had to stretch my left leg out across the aisle of the plane to even fit there. I have flown in many small airplanes before. My ex-husband was a private pilot and flight instructor so I am aware and understand how weight and balance works. I will say that Marcus was polite, professional and his landing was one of the softess I've ever experienced. he would do well to brush up on his knowledge of the pine tree was on the island...We're going back to Kauai again but we will not be giving these people our business. I did not feel at all welcome or like they wanted or appreciated our business, unfortunate but true....

Review Title: A brilliant way to see the Kauai
Review Text:
While we were on vacation in Kauai we wanted to see as much of the island as possible and, as I’m a pilot, looked for an opportunity to fly and sight-see from a fixed wing aircraft. Helicopters are ok but they can be a bit of a nuisance for people on the ground. Plus Bruce’s Cessna 172 is a much less expensive way to do this. We arranged (before we left home in North Carolina) to take an island tour via dual flight instruction from Bruce Coulombe of Wings Over Kauai. We met Bruce’s colleague at Lihue airport and she did a short briefing and the weight and balance. Bruce then showed us around the aircraft and we climbed aboard. After a thoroughly professional preflight and engine start/run up we were ready to go. My wife was in the back and I had the right seat – for a better view of the island. We were cleared for take off from runway 3 and immediately after lift-off could see the beautiful island spread out below, and as it happened the resort where we were staying. We flew along the coast and Bruce – who has lived on the island for a long time, initially while working as a scientist for a big agriculture company and then for the next few thousand hours of flying around Kauai – pointed out the places we were flying over. Basically for the next 50 minutes this included all of the island highlights, and Bruce’s comments and background information made this a data-rich tour. When we were approaching Lihue airport, we had to do a 360 because of departing traffic, and then were cleared to land on runway 3.
This was a brilliant way for us to see the island, as well as for me to get 1.1 hours unforgettable instruction for the logbook. The helicopter tours may be ok for passengers, but believe us, Bruce’s tour will stay with you – a pilot – as one of the best flights ever, and especially if you get the dvd of the flight for an accurate record with all the details. And with money you save flying with Bruce rather than doing a helicopter tour, you could have dinner for the next 3 nights at the Bamboo Grill and Sushi overlooking the bay at Lihue. What a great day!
Aloha and mahalo Bruce.

Review Text: I was originally looking into helicopter tours but was worried about my wife getting motion sickness and the costs are pretty expensive. Our experience with booking, confirmation, directions and everything leading up to the flight was flawless.  On the day of our flight we met with Bruce who owns the company and was also our pilot and went through a thorough pre-flight briefing and were on our way.  Bruce shared his vast knowledge of the island as we flew by all the spectacular sights which added a nice touch to the tour.  We started out at 3:30 in hopes that the weather would be a little clearer (always a gamble on any day) and the sun would be better for some pictures along the Waimea Canyon and Na Pali Coast.  We lucked out and the scenery was amazing.  While you aren't right up on things like you might be in a helicopter I found that the views were still excellent and met my expectations.  Although the configuration of an airplane isn't the optimum for taking professional photos (and really only a doors off helicopter is optimal), my wife and I managed to get many great shots.  Wings Over Kauai also provides the option to purchase a high def go-pro video of your flight which is a nice touch as well that you could also grab still images from.  Overall our experience was excellent and I would highly recommend Bruce and Wings Over Kauai as an alternative to high priced and crowded heli-tours.

He pointed out and narrated important facts about all the popular sites/places that we're seeing throughout the tour while at the same time engaging us and answering all our questions.

We were fortunate enough to have great weather during our entire week in Kauai. This is indeed the best way to see the grandeur of the Waimea Canyon, the beauty of the majestic Na Pali coast and the hundreds of water falls in Kauai. This tour was really awesome and made us appreciate and love Kauai even more.

This was truly an outstanding tour and Wings over Kauai is the best air tour company in Kauai.

We chose Wings Over Kauai as my boyfriend had never been on a small plane, and it was MUCH cheaper than the helicopter tours (our tour was $300). This company had the best customer service ever! On our scheduled day, we arrived early and Mary got us checked in, weighed, etc. The wind was really picking up and it looked like a big rainstorm was moving in. Mary checked with Marcus (the pilot) to see how conditions were elsewhere on the island. Marcus replied that conditions were not very good for sightseeing and getting worse. He and Mary suggested that we should cancel for the day and try again the next morning, in the hopes of a much better trip. Note: we had booked an afternoon trip but Marcus and Mary said that morning trips are usually a better bet for good weather and visibility. We got booked onto a tour the next morning with no problem and at no charge.
Meanwhile, we asked Mary for recommendations on what to do since it looked like a thunderstorm was moving in. She suggested going to the west or south side of the island which she said was usually sunny. Since we had a Jeep, she recommended we go to Polihale Beach. This turned out to be breathtaking, and we were so glad she recommended it!
The next morning we went on our tour. There were two other people with us, and we all had window seats. Also provided in the plane were waters, cool wet towels, ginger candies, and ginger ale for motion sickness. My boyfriend got motion sick, and the pilot and other passengers were most helpful in helping me get him the towels, ginger, etc. to feel better.
Marcus was an excellent guide, and had personal stories about some of the sights we saw, as well as general information, which helped make the flight tour that much better.
We had our picture taken with the plane before flight, and when we returned, we got a CD with our picture and some of the music that was played during the flight. Unlike some other companies, there was no charge for this great souvenir.
We thought the plane tour was better than doing a helicopter tour as we were able to fly higher and get better views and pictures of sights such as the Na Pali coast. We saw helicopters that were flying lower and closer to the cliffs, but we preferred to have our views of the entire cliff from top to bottom, instead of just a small portion of the cliffs.
This was our favorite thing we did on Kauai, this is a must-do!

Review Text:
As a pilot with a student certificate, I wanted to take the controls myself and Wings over Kauai was the obvious choice. We booked an instructional flight in the 172 with Bruce, the owner of the company. Now, for all certified pilots out there: you will not be able to rent a plane by yourself in Kauai and neither should you. The tour traffic (especially helicopters) is busy, constant and organized. It is important to check in on the advisory frequency for position updates and if you don't know the informal landmarks, you'll be spending your flight trying to figure out which valley a chopper is going to pop out out of next. Additionally, you have to deal with mountain/ocean flying, comply with noise abatement rules and the Pacific Missile Range restricted area. Let Bruce handle the radio and big picture navigation so you can enjoy the flying and scenery.

Since my flight was pre-checkride, Bruce threw in a few exam questions here and there, gave me general directions, offered some helpful tips that you can only get from an 11,000 hour pilot, and otherwise let me pick my path between the clouds. He pointed out landmarks and places of interest, and supplied some tour-guide type narration.

We had a good weather day (there are always some clouds in Kauai) and the view was spectacular. We followed the established clockwise direction around the island which is flown by all tour aircraft. We saw whales, the steep cliffs of the Na'pali Coast, craters, beaches, reefs etc.

The main difference to a helicopter tour (which we did the same day) is that helicopters can get into spaces the plane cannot. The two are different experiences. With the helo rides you're part of a group and get herded like cattle through the safety video and the tour. With the plane, you miss out on those tight canyons and close-up waterfalls, but you have your own plane and can pick your route. Plus, it's a lot cheaper AND YOU GET TO FLY YOURSELF. If you load the plane with 3 people the price is about $100 per person/hour. Compare that to $260/person on the choppy for the 55 min ride. Plus, if you're stuck in the back middle seats on the helo, your visibility is quite restricted. On the Cessna the windows might be smaller, but at least everyone has their own.

Anyway, we returned to Lihue Airport, I made a nice-enough landing, and taxied back to the ramp in front of two Hawaiian Airlines Boeings. If you're a pilot, you know what I'm talking about.

All in all, Wings over Kauai is a down-to-earth, family-run small business, and not a multi-island, slick and smooth helo operation. No memorabilia shop, t-shirts and upsells. They have GoPros mounted on the plane for those who like that sort of thing, but they don't push their video as much as the other outfits. Wings over Kauai is a more than viable alternative to the helicopter rides, especially if you don't want to spend $750 for a family of three. They also have a Cessna Caravan for larger groups (or mixed groups).

Review Text:
We really had a great time with Wings Over Kauai. We were in the area for a day and a half on the Pride Of America cruise ship. I decided to schedule our flight for 930am the second day. The first day we arrived it was pretty cloudy and rainy, so I was bummed that the weather was going to stay the same and we wouldn't see much. Thankfully the second day it was totally clear and nice! Even the top of Waialeale was clear!

The day of our trip we were picked up promptly near the cruise ship as arraigned. We went over the basics- safety, weigh-in, and some pictures next to the plane. Our pilot was Josh (a former American Airlines pilot), and he got us buckled in to our assigned seats. I was in the copilot seat, and my wife was behind me. Once in the air, Josh told us lots of facts about what we were seeing while music played. The Na Pali coast was beautiful and we had great viewing weather. I did get a bit of haze in my pictures, which looked worse on the camera's LCD than the final picture (I used a telephoto lens with a polarizing filter). Before we knew it, it was time to land. I really enjoyed getting to listen to air traffic control the whole time also.

Once back at the airport, they gave everyone a free gift (I won't ruin the surprise). They also offered to sell us a DVD of the full flight, filmed by GoPros mounted under the wings and inside the cabin. The price was very reasonable, and it arrived by the time we got home. It was a great keepsake to have, and the views were so much better than what I captured on my camera. They offered to drop us off back at the cruise ship or the mall, and gave my wife a flower for her hair. Everyone we met was extremely nice and we really enjoyed the flight.

One note, if you have even the slightest problem with motion sickness, take a dramamine pill before you fly. We were lucky to have a pretty smooth flight, but small slow planes like this are more prone to thermals and winds than large jets. We experienced a few quick stomach-drops, that felt kind of a like a roller coaster hill. My wife did feel a little airsick, but the dramamine stopped her from throwing up. They do have a cooler on board with sprite and ginger chews, but better safe than sorry.

Don't hesitate to get a great view of Kauai, book a flight!

We agreed, changed our schedule around, and got the confirmation email. The next day, they emailed us to say that they were mistaken and the two-seater plane was not actually available. They asked if we'd mind switching back to Thursday afternoon on a four-seater plane (but a private tour). We were pretty frustrated, spent about two hours trying to find a different operator (ideally, a helicopter) and after finding that this was by far the cheapest option, agreed to switch our schedule around (again) to go on Thursday afternoon.

Besides the booking hiccup, the tour was great. Josh was our pilot and he was wonderful. We had a very clear day and the sights were incredible. You really do get a view of Kauai unlike anything else.

Though we had an incredible experience and could not have afforded the helicopter tour, we do feel like we missed out by not doing the helicopter tour. While we were circling well above the sights, we had a clear view of the helicopter tours zooming in, out, and around the canyons and other secluded areas. This is a tremendous tour for the value and the staff are wonderful, but if we go back we'd do a helicopter tour instead of a small plane tour.

Overall, if you're too nervous for a helicopter or can't splurge for it, this is a FABULOUS alternative.

Review Title: Fantastic tour!!  A must for Kauai!
Review Text: We went in their small plane for the tour over Kauai, there were six of us including the pilot.  They picked us up at the ABC store, just up the street from the pier, where our ship docked.  If you don't want to take the ten minute walk you can jump on the free shuttle that takes you to the little mall where the ABC store located.  When I read all the previous comments about Wings Over Kauai we decided to go with them, and we're very happy we did!!  For $125.00 US we got a whole hour in the air.  If they keep that up they will continue to be busy and recommended by people like myself.  I've already told many people to go with them.  They were nice enough to offer us free water and pop during our flight, that was great!  The best part of the tour, is seeing Kauai, it's beautiful!!  For anyone sitting on the passenger side of the plane, you will see better.  If your on the pilots side, you will see everything but not as well and throughly as the others, but the pilot does try his best.  I think it's due to the time it takes to fly the plane around so everyone can see as well.  I would still recommend it anyways.  If price doesn't matter and you want a shorter ride then you can take a helicopter ride, which flies lower and takes you closer to the mountains.  Make sure to bring your camera!!  Go to the washroom and get in the plane!!  They do have good walk up steps to the plane, so even if you have some disabilities you shouldn't have a problem.  If you leave yourself three hours from getting to the mall, filling out the paperwork, getting weighed, get on the plane and the flight back, you should be good.  Ellen picked us up and was,so nice.  We met her husband and our pilot, Josh, along with Ellen's daughter, and they were all so nice and friendly.  Josh was an excellent,pilot, constantly talking to us all during the flight and answering any questions we had.  Can't lose taking this tour, especially as its the only way to see the canyon and the Na Pali coast without hiking and a boat, which would take days.  Kauai is so beautiful and you appreciate it more from the air.

Review Text:
Kauai is our favorite island. There’s just something different about it. It has a different feel, a different vibe. Maybe it’s the chickens everywhere, or the cattle or the more mature landscape. Just not sure. From the air, it’s gorgeous. We flew Wings Over Kauai. Very, very nice people. We were very lucky in that the other people on our flight cancelled, so we had the entire Caravan to ourselves. Bruce, the owner, was our pilot. We took off on 30, NW, turned right and circled the island clockwise. Got great pictures during a flyover of the Crown at dock. The day was partly cloudy with clouds and rain over the center of the island. The water was pure aqua blue, the coastline just picture perfect rocks and white spray and the green of the trees contrasting with the red of the soil could not be done justice in a photo. We cut inland up Wameia Canyon, saw the Jurassic Park waterfall, flew inland of the Pacific Missile Test Range main base, but cut back out over the ocean just before we go to the northern most telemetry radars sitting on top of one giant cliff.

Flew along the Napoli Coast. Saw the trail wind its way through the cliffs, on top of huge sea caves and along knife edge ridges of rock. Broke back over the northern coast over the resorts and golf courses and the locations they filmed Jurassic World. Cut around the NW part of the island, flew a circle around the Fantasy Island waterfall, saw the cattle grazing in almost chartreuse meadows, flew back over the ship and landed back on runway 30. The whole trip was about 70 minutes, at a ground speed of around 90mph. Judy filmed the whole thing with the action cam, and I took about 160+ stills. We also ordered a video of the flight. They had GoPro’s on each wing.

This was one of the best value excursions we’ve ever had in Hawaii. Judy did get a little queasy coming around the hills to the NW of the airport. The air was a bit bumpy, but not bad at all. Nothing like the helicopter we took in Juneau in 2001.

Review Text:
Selbst mehrere Wochen nach unserer Rückkehr aus Kauai und unserem 60 minütigen Rundflug über die Insel mit 'Wings over Kauai' schwärmen wir immer noch über dieses Erlebnis.
Wir hatten die Grand Deluxe Tour in der "AirVan" Maschine gebucht. Wir hatten die komplette Maschine für 4 Personen als Private Tour gebucht, aber auch für Gruppen bis zu 6 Personen ist die Maschine geeignet.
Man wird im Flughafenbüro sehr herzlich willkommen geheißen, dann gibt es ein paar Infos über den bevorstehenden Flug und man wird gewogen. Die Sitzplatzvergabe erfolgt durch 'Wings over Kauai', der Computer errechnet die optimale "Gewichtsverteilung" im Flugzeug für den bevorstehenden Flug. Doch wirklich JEDER Passagier hat einen Fensterplatz und dadurch eine optimale Sicht.
Nach der freundlichen Begüßung geht es dann über das Vorfeld zur Maschine, hier kann man noch Fotos machen bevor es dann endlich losgeht.
Kostenlose Getränke während des Fluges werden übrigens auch angeboten.
Unser Pilot hieß Josh, er war nicht nur sehr sympatisch sondern er verstand es, in angenehmer Weise uns den gesamten Flug gut zu unterhalten. Jeder Passagier kann über die Headsets miteinander während des Fluges kommunizieren, außerdem spielt der Pilot Musik in den Hintergrund ein, z.B. beim Überflug über die Jurassic Park Wasserfälle wird die Titelmusik von Jurassic Park eingespielt usw.

Die 60 Minuten gingen leider sehr schnell vorbei, die gabze Schönheit der Insel kann man bestaunen, man erhält tolle Infos vom Piloten, kann jederzeit Rückfragen stellen. Der Überflug über die Na Pali Coast ist sicherlich ein Highlight, da man diese ja sonst nicht zugänglich ist. Aber auch der Flug über den Canyon und die unzähligen einsamen Buchten verleitet zum Träumen.

Nach der Landung hat man die Möglichkeit ein Video von seinem Flug zu kaufen. Es sind mehrere Kameras am Flugzeug angebracht, diese zeichnen die Tour auf, es gibt auch eine Kamera die den Innenraum des Flugzeugs filmt, ausserdem wird die Konversation aufgezeichnet sodass man hinterher alles nochmal in Ruhe anschauen kann.
Dadurch dass alles aufgezeichnet wird, kann man sich auf den Flug konzentrieren und die Aussicht geniessen.

Das Video(HD Qualität) kann man u.a. per Download Link erwerben, wir haben ca USD 50,- dafür bezahlt.

Abschließend möchten wir uns nochmals bei Wings over Kauai und besonders bei Josh bedanken: es war ein unvergessliches Erlebnis!
Sollten wir nochmals nach Kauai kommen, werden wir definitiv wieder einen Rundflug buchen!

Review Title: Brilliant!  Must do in Kauai. Kids loved it.
Review Text:

Plane flights do not go as deep into the canyons, but they are longer and in our opinion more enjoyable as everyone gets a better view (in helicopters you can find yourself in the middle in the back with other guests getting the good view.)

In researching our flight, Wings over Kauai provided great information via email and over the phone so we booked with them a few weeks before travelling to Kauai. The day prior our flight, we received a confirmation email with detailed instructions. On arrival at the airport the greeting was friendly, safety was clearly important and everything was explained clearly. Prior to take off the took a group photo which we received via email after the flight.

The flight with Josh was brilliant. We had the 6 seater to ourselves (2 adults & two kids) so everyone could sit not he right side of the plane which has the best views. You wear headsets with microphones so you can hear the pilots excellent explanation and you can talk to the others in the plane. They Gopro the whole flight inside and outside and for $50 you can buy the high res video (it is ready 3 days after the flight. Can't wait to see it.)

All I can say is you MUST see the Napali coastline either from the air or boat. We chose the air and did not regret it.

All in all a brilliant experience and Wings over Kauai was more than excellent. Highly recommended.

Review Text: We chose to fly with Wings over Kauai because their rates were very competitive (especially compared to the helicopter tour with the Pride of America!). There was a cooler with cold drinks and towels as there was limited air circulation in the plane itself. I did get a little motion sick because I was taking too many pictures - there's a lot to see! The flight was a good length for me (1 hourish). I will say that helicopters seem to be able to get closer to the sites than planes, but other than that, highly recommended. When we got back, they gave us a pre-recorded DVD of some of the best sites from the Go-Pros all over the plane with a cover that featured a picture of us before the flight and the opportunity to purchase a DVD of our specific flight - we did purchase the DVD which was mailed to us about a week later - it's excellent quality.

Review Title: Awesome Air Tour of Kauai - especially if value keeping your lunch down
Review Text:
So this was my 3rd time to Hawaii, 2nd with my family. I vividly remember my first time, which was my honeymoon, because that's when I had my first helicopter ride in Hawaii. I spent a small fortune on a "champagne" tour and ended up losing my lunch because helicopters can be very disorienting in tight spaces like waterfalls and canyons.

So this time I took a different strategy and booked a 60 minute flight with Wings Over Kauai. And I must say the experience was very enjoyable and didn't bother my stomach in the least.

Bruce, the Pilot, was very friendly and personable. He is also one of the owners of the company and turned his flying hobby into a 2nd career after leaving the agricultural field where he had a PhD.

We were a family of four and everyone had a clear window seat. We toured the entire island, including the Waimea canyon, Napali coast, and saw a half dozen great waterfalls, including the one from Fantasy Island. Sitting in the front for takeoff and landing was also pretty cool.

One thing I did not do was read the FAQ on the site about best times to fly. One suggestion was that afternoon flights gave you better lighting on the Napali coast and the canyon for photography. And while I agree that might have reduced the glare from the cockpit somewhat for photos, overall our 930am flight was fine and the weather was beautiful and my photos turned out fine. Bruce had a lot of good tips.

After the flight Bruce also provided us with some tips on his favorite things to do / places to eat which were very good.

Thanks again to Bruce and his assistant Angel for a truly great experience. I definitely felt less queazy and safer in a plane than I did in a helicopter.

Review Text:

We're here at the perfect time." And he was right. It was gorgeous.

The tour lasted about an hour. Our eleven-year old twins loved it. The plane was small enough (sized to hold 6 passengers and the pilot), that our son could watch the instrument panel and reported afterward how fast we were going and how high we were off the ground. Definitely bring a camera. And don't forget to use it! The scenery is so breathtaking its easy to get lost gazing at it.

Review Title: Worth the time and money if your time in Kauai is limited (cruise)
Review Text:
If on a cruise - book on your own. This is a family-owned operation with only two airplanes - Dr. Bruce Coulombe, young retired research scientist, head of the family. My wife searched Kauai flights after we booked a cruise from Tahiti to Los Angeles with stops at four Hawaiian islands. The cruise excursions are costly. Our time on Kauai was limited. Wings Over Kauai had the best price offer, and were friendly when the reservations were made (about three months in advance). Bruce met my wife and me at the cruise port and drove us to the airport. Since more people booked for the same hour, instead of flying in the larger six passenger aircraft, we volunteered to be flown in the Cessna Skyhawk - just the pilot, my wife and myself. The pilot was well versed on what we to see below. Bruce returned us to our ship.

A retired judicial professional couple who were with us on the cruise and lived on Kauai told us that the fixed wing aircraft were much safer than helicopter flights. They told us that far more helicopter accidents (fatal) occur than happens with fixed wing aircraft. Helicopters do fly closer to the canyons and water falls. Might be the reason they crash more often.

Worth the time and money spent.

Review Text:
A big thanks to Bruce, Ellen, and Captain Josh for the excellent service they provided to our group of 6 cruise ship passengers yesterday. Bruce picked us up at the Anchor Cove Mall, which is close to the cruise terminal, and he and Ellen checked us in and took pictures of us in front of the plane before we took off, which we received via email today. Our pilot Josh provided very informative comments as we flew over the Jurassic park waterfall, Waimea Canyon, and the Na Pali coast and he let us know when we were approaching the best sights for photos. We were blessed with a clear day, so we got some amazing photos!

My only criticisms are that the seat beside the window in the back row has very little leg room and the 2 of us seated on the left side of the plane missed a lot of the best sights because most of them are on the right side. The AirVan has 1 passenger seat on the right beside the pilot, 2 seats in the second row, 1 seat on the right in the third row (which is where you enter the plane), and 2 seats right beside each other to the right of the fourth row. It is very difficult for the person seated on the left behind the pilot to see out the right window because of the space between the seats. The two seats in the back row where my husband and I sat are close together, but the windows in that row are smaller, so the person sitting beside the window obstructs most of the view of the person sitting on the left. Had I known this in advance, I would have booked the plane for 4 persons instead of 6 persons so that we could all sit on the right side (if that is even possible). Despite these issues, I saw some wonderful views and highly recommend Wings Over Kauai.
Disclaimer: This review is the subjective opinion of a Tripadvisor member and not of Tripadvisor LLC.

Review Text:
Before our air tour, my family made the long drive up through Waimea Canyon to the end of the road at Pu'u O Kila which has an amazing view of the Kalalau Valley. I've seen it before and it is spectacular. This time, it was totally clouded over and you couldn't see to the other side.
I thought this is definitely not going to be a good day for an air tour. We were not going to see anything!
Fortunately, weather changes and it did big time by the time our tour started at 2:30.
Josh was our pilot. He did a great job of showing us everything. The rain and cloud cover that morning turned into a huge blessing. We saw so many waterfalls. And the skies were clear even above Mt. Wai'ale'ale.
The speed of the aircraft was nice and slow, we didn't miss a thing. Josh was able to angle/lean/tilt the aircraft in a way so that passengers on both sides got to see certain waterfalls and sights he was describing.
It was such an awesome experience. It was also an excellent value for our family of six. My wife and I have done the helicopter tour in the past. This was just as nice.
A big Mahalo from the Hitchcock ohana!

Review Title: Great air tour, totally worth it!
Review Text: If weight or motion-sickness is an issue or you are overly safety-concious, touring Kauai by plane rather than helicopter is definitely the right decision. Wings Over Kauai is a great value that offers an interesting one hour(ish) tour around the island. Our pilot was Josh, who sounded exactly like a pilot on TV would sound (he should be a radio announcer) and was very knowledgable and personable. We saw lots of waterfalls, the Na Pali coast, private beaches and homes, and the Waimea Canyon. Josh was also really knowledgable about the different hikes available and was able to point out where some hikes begin or end. The plane ride is over before you know it, which is sad because it is so much fun. Keep in mind: a plane has to travel much higher than a helicopter, so you don't get as close to the sights as you might like. But the airplane tour really gives you a great idea of the island and how all those sights come together as a whole. It is really cool to see from the air all the places you have been to or will go to on land.
