Review Text:
I'm a 300+ hour visiting pilot, and had contacted Wings over Kauai to see if I could fly left seat in their C172 - they got back to me and said sure, and so this week off we went, with Bruce in the right seat, me in the left, and my wife in the back.

The C172 he flies is in excellent condition; fuel injected, steam gauges, well maintained. I particularly liked that Bruce didn't mind me doing my own preflight or questioning him on the oil level and fuel before engine start. I really respect that.

As an instructor, Bruce is fantastic. He has input if you want it, or he'll just let you get on and fly. He's obviously a solid pilot (as he should be, at 10,000+ hours). and knows the local landscape and procedures well.

We flew around the island, safely, and enjoyably. He's got decent ANR headsets, his folks are awesome, and I can't imagine a better experience.

All in all, if you are a visiting pilot, you would be CRAZY to miss this experience. Much safer than a helicopter (not to mention cheaper), run by folks who really are focused on safety AND fun, good flight instruction (I was on the stick the whole flight). I can't say enough good things. Mahalo, Bruce!

Review Title: Wings Not Rotors Plus A 360-Degree Double Rainbow
Review Text: This is an aerial tour by plane, not by helicopter.  Another couple went with us and one of our party becomes motion sick relatively easily.  The company's FAQ's address this issue and the information was accurate.  Our pilot was aware of the issue and tried to make the ride as gentle as possible for her.  We booked the 4:00 pm Grand Deluxe Tour in the G8 AirVan.  Because the fare for two couples ($125 per person, $500.00 for the two couples) equaled the "private charter" fare, we opted for that so only the four of us and, of course, the pilot were on the plane.  Upon arrival, we were greeted by Mary who was very friendly and accommodating.  Because the weather during the day had been rainy, she did not take our credit cards until she spoke to our pilot, Josh, about the weather.  Josh had just returned from a tour and gave the green light for our flight in that his opinion was that the weather was clearing and that this would be the best tour of the day.  His prophesy was correct. The ride was relatively smooth, although there were a few bumpy spots.  However, we were fortunate to see a 360-degree double rainbow (we didn't know a 360-degree rainbow existed, but it does and can only be seen from the air) along the Napali Coast.  Simply spectacular!  The views are all from the right side of the plane.  The windows are big so it is easy to take photos if you want.  But if you just want to sit back and enjoy the experience, the plane is equipped with several cameras and you can purchase a DVD, Blue-Ray or video download link at the end of the trip ($35 for the DVD and $50 for the Blue-Ray or video download link) that shows your trip and includes the pilot's commentary, music and the passengers' conversations (you wear a headset with a mike and can talk with the other passengers and pilot).  Before the plane took off, I noticed that Mary cleaned all of the windows on the plane -- nice touch.  The plane flies at a relatively slow speed of 90 mph and the tour lasts about 65 minutes.  Josh did a nice commentary and fielded the questions we had.  Josh was friendly and according to the women in our party, "not hard to look at."  He said that he had been doing this tour for four years and had been flying in the Hawaian Islands for seven years.  If you want a great overview (no pun intended) of the island's features, including numerous waterfalls and movie locations, and  some of its attractions, we highly recommend this tour.

Of course I looked on TripAdvisor for help. I started with helicopter tours and trying to fit it in my budget. Then I noticed "Wings over Kauai" a couple attractions below and went to their website. Saw they used those small prop planes (good for those that get motion-sick) and then I saw they had a combo tour. Looked at the price and had to call to confirm....it was no joke! I called them to book the tours. The receptionist was very friendly and helpful. Helped me upgrade to a smaller plane (not much more) so we would have it all to ourselves. Emailed me the details and confirmation right away. Was no trouble at all.

When we arrived in Lihue, picked up our rental car and drove literally only 5 mins to arrive at the office/plane. Definitely recommend, if possible, to book your air tour the day you arrive because it's so close to the airport and you won't need to come back to the area if you plane to stay outside of Lihue.

The girl working in the office was very friendly and also the pilots daughter. We waited a few minutes for the pilot to get the plane ready and we were off. They let us take pictures in front of the plane and will even give you a CD copy of your our after.

The pilot was nice, friendly, funny and best of all knowledgeable. Told us some stories and history about places we were flying over. He interacted with us when we asked questions. He was so personable that he made us feel comfortable and relaxed (definitely helped me because I easily get motion-sickness).

If you're looking to do something different and you're on a budget (or if you easily get motion-sickness) then I highly recommend this company. It's family-owned so they take real good care of you and make sure that you have an awesome experience. Great way to see the entire island in an hour.

Review Text:
This flight was a real highlight of our trip. There were six of us, so we were able to have the six-passenger "Air-Van" all to ourselves at somewhat of a discount relative to the per person price. There were some schedule changes, but Dori in their office was very accommodating and made it work. We took the flight the first day after arriving. The areal view really oriented us to the layout of the island.

The weather was exceptional. Visibility was great, very few clouds or haze; you could see entirely across the island as well as the mountain tops. The water was flat and clear, so we could see the sand and the coral under the surface. Just after take-off we saw a whale swimming near the surface with its calf. The pilot, Captain Josh, made a 360 degree turn around this sight, so we could get a good view. We saw many other whales, but from a greater distance.

The take-offs and landings were extremely smooth, and turns were all gentle and even. If you want more of a thrill ride, you might choose the helicopters, which fly much lower and closer to the sights. We had some nervous fliers who are prone to air sickness, so the plane ride was just right for us. It was exhilarating due to the views, not the motion.

Captain Josh was friendly, knowledgeable and fun. We felt very safe and comfortable. He point out many sights, related many anecdotes and answered all our questions. We wore microphoned headsets and were all able to hear each other. Josh ran a Hawaiian and movie themed sound tract that we enjoyed very much. Since the route is primarily a clockwise circle of the island, he doubled back on a couple of occasions, so the the people on the left side of the plane would also get good views. He also navigated up canyons where both sides had good views.

The plane is equipped with about six GoPro cameras, including one wide-angle camera inside the cockpit. They construct a video with a soundtrack of the entire trip and video that includes interior and exterior views. We bought the 1080P copy of the video and are very happy we did. What a great memory!

I would happily take this same flight again.

Review Text:
We had a wonderful time on our flight with Wings Over Kauai! I had looked at helicopter tours as well, but we chose a fixed-wing flight because it's far safer (check out Kauai Underground Guide's table of helicopter tour fatalities, also because it's an awesome guide), it's half the price, and I had read reviews that the view you get from the helicopter tours is a 'luck of the draw' situation.

We booked a 4 person AirVan Private Charter, the flight takes a sort of clockwise tour of the island so we were all seated on the left to ensure we all had excellent views. And excellent views we had! Whales, canyons, Na Pali coast, waterfalls, extinct volcanoes, river valleys...you name it, we saw it, and it was stunning. The bubble windows allow you to see below and above the plane, in addition to out to the side.

Bruce, a retired agronomist and our guide to the skies, seemed almost as excited to be on our flight as we were. He proved to be an incredibly talented pilot and knowledgeable (and entertaining) guide to the Garden Isle. I love flying, but my boyfriend and sister were a bit nervous about being in a small plane--if you are, don't let this stop you from booking with Wings Over Kauai! That was probably the smoothest flight I've ever been on.

During our booking process Ellen was extremely accommodating and responsive to emails. Our original tour date wound up being incredibly stormy, and we were able to reschedule for a sunny day. Do bear in mind that Kauai is subject to changeable and sometimes stormy weather, if it is not safe to fly your tour will be cancelled. Ellen will do all she can to reschedule your tour in such an event, but if your stay is short this may be difficult. So make sure you stay for awhile, because Kauai is absolutely amazing and a Wings Over Kauai flight shouldn't be missed!!

Now for the downsides: Apparently, the passengers are greeted with a lei - we were'nt. We saw several helicopters flying lower and closer to the Napali coast and in the Waimea Canyon. Don't count on this, but a big bonus for me was, I got the co-pilot's seat, and that allowed me the perfect vantage point for some real nice photos and go-pro videos. Not sure how they decide on who sits there, but you can ask. On helicopters you pay extra for the front seats but that's not the case with the planes. My wife sat in the 'passenger' section, and the views there were amazing as well.

As one of the other reviewer said, you get a small momento after the flight, and we got the same. Really nice touch.

Recommendations: look at the forecast a couple days in advance and book accordingly. We had a nice sunny day and that made the ride. If it's cloudy, I'm sure it won't be the same. Ask for a right-side seat, or even the co-pilot seat if possible.

Needless to say, we would fly with them again if we visit in a few years' time, and would recommend these guys with out hesitation.

Review Text: Best morning of my life.  Period.  I think our whole group (8 total) agree that Wings over Kauai was exceptional. I was so overwhelmed with joy and awe when we flew over the Na Pali Coast I started to tear up.  I felt like such a sap but it really was something unique to see & experience.  Captain Josh took extra time to fly so we could see the Cessna that held the other 2 members of our group.  No worries about being in a small plane - the whole flight felt safer to me than commercial air travel.  I am too chicken to get into a helicopter so that is why our group ended up in the planes.  We were so lucky to experience such a beautiful and meaningful event.  As others have mentioned they offer the flight on DVD/Blu Ray or digital download that we all have been enjoying and sharing with anyone who will watch it since we got home. Review Title: This will be your top Kauai / Hawaii experience!
Review Text:
We went on the 4 p.m. Cessna ride on Thu, 10/9, the latest flight of the day. This plane ride was phenomenal! We visited the island as part of the Norwegian Cruise Line, Pride of America cruise. This is not an excursion offered by NCL, we found it courtesy of Google and are so glad we did! We originally were looking for a helicopter tour when we fortunately stumbled upon this incredible alternative. Our homework paid off.
Riding in the Cessna with Wings over Kauai offered several great advantages. 1) This was effectively a private tour - it was the pilot, my wife and me. 2) I love photography. The pilot allowed me to open the window to take glare-free photographs of the spectacular views offered by the plane. (See several scaled down photos below) 3) We spent a fraction of the cost of a helicopter tour. 4) It's hard to imagine a helicopter tour topping this one. 5) The pilot, Josh, was very skilled and professional, had a wealth of knowledge about the island and was extremely personable. His easy going demeanor quickly put us at ease and set the tone for a an incredible flying experience. 6) This is a family owned business. The owner gave us a ride back to the cruise ship - a personal touch we wouldn't expect from the larger helicopter companies. 7) The incredible Napali Coast is only accessible by air or water. Since the cruise ship takes you by the coast, we were able to see the coast from both perspectives. Viewing it by air is much more dramatic and impactful. If you are going to Hawaii, Kauai is a must-see island. If you are going to Kauai, the Napali Coast is a must-see destination, so we recommend seeing it the best way possible - by air!
It's a shame NCL doesn't offer this as one of their shore excursions - so many cruise passengers are missing out. On the other hand, if it was an NCL offering the price might be much higher, so it will pay great dividends for the traveller (cruiser or non-cruiser alike) who does their homework.
If you are visiting the islands via NCL, you will arrive in Kauai on Thursday at 8:00 a.m. and leave on Friday at 2:00 p.m. If you take this flight on Friday, do so earlier in the morning so you don't risk missing the boat that afternoon. We chose to take the late Thursday afternoon flight in lieu of the only NCL offered luau Thursday night. What a great decision! Because half of the ship's cruisers were off-ship attending the luau, we returned to the ship, ate supper in a much quieter restaurant, then had the pool completely to ourselves for over an hour!

Review Text:
Found this place from all the wonderful reviews online. Was planning on doing another outing/adventure but price seemed a little steep for the activity. When I found this for the same price there was no hesitation in booking! We booked the 9:30 flight because after calling and talking to Ellen she suggested the time and day based on the weather over the weekend. Turned out to be perfect! Got there, chatted with Dori and Josh who were so welcoming and nice. We got checked in and waited only 15 or so minutes to board. They were knowledgable and kind, telling us about the plane and where to sit. We took pictures outside the plane and boarded. I have to say I was nervous prior to boarding because I hadn't been in such a small plane before but the fears were pretty much dissipated by the time I took my seat. Josh was so personable and kind, gave us clear instructions on the headsets and what to do. They even let my fiancée sit in the co pilots seat because it was her birthday--trip maker! We got into the air smoothly and easily and the hour long tour was great! Full of knowledge and fun tidbits, josh was an awesome tour guide. The scenerary was breathtaking and we got amazing photos! We only had one patch of some turbulence that felt a little roller coastery but Josh reassured us it was normal and it was smooth sailing then on. I was worried about air sickness but I felt nothing. They do provide "aloha" bags ;) and ginger candies and water should anyone need anything while in the air. The one thing I will say is that it was a warm day and I was pretty warm during the flight despite the air vent. So be prepared, I'd suggest layers.

If your looking for a memorable adventure while on Kauai, I would suggest doing this because it was awesome, the customer service was beyond amazing and overall it was a fantastic trip! So happy we booked it. Go, you won't be disappointed!

Review Title: You Haven't Seen Kauai Unless You've Been on Wings
Review Text:
This was our favorite experience on the island. Staying in Lihue, this was a very convenient pick-up location. Time wise, you get the biggest return on investment if your time on the island is limited. In one hour, you get to see so many amazing views of this island that are not feasable by foot, boat, or car. The center of the island is just so incredibly breathtaking. You will see miles of amazing vegitation and waterfalls with no human life... it's truly something I've never seen before.

I suffer from motion sickness (in fact, we took a boat ride/ snorkeling excursion on which I got queezy despite taking Dramamine) and had NO PROBLEMS AT ALL on Wings Over Kauai. My biggest challenge was nervousness which was much eased by Capt. Josh and Dori. The service is so friendly and personal. Dori gave us a great overview of our trip and made us feel so welcome. Capt. Josh made us feel comfortable, casually describing his experience as a pilot (having flown both large planes for major airlines and flying small planes as well) and often referring to us by name during our flight, often checking up on us and even wishing me a happy birthday!

I took Dramamine an hour before the flight. They offered ginger candy and water/soda on the plane. Views from the right we're better as many other reviewers mentioned. I have a small threshold for comfort when it comes to temperature and the ride was not too hot, not too cold but juuuuuust right. We went at 2:30pm and thought the lighting and views were beyond spectacular.

The ride may seem pricey to you but I promise, it's well worth it... You can't spend hundreds of dollars to fly and stay in Kauai and NOT spend another $100-200 to have this experience.

Review Text:
We took a plane tour over Kauai with WOK in September. We have been to Hawaii seven times having visited Oahu, Big Island, Maui and Kauai. Easy to say Kauai is our favorite, as it is a very beautiful, restful island. We enjoy the beaches, swimming, snorkeling. We have seen more sea turtles, rays, dolphins, etc. here than anywhere else. We have been in awe of the Na Pali coast on catamaran trips (Capt Andy is the best), but this trip we tried another method of enjoying the beauty of the island. Yes, Wings Over Kauai.

The staff is super friendly. We flew with owner/pilot Bruce. Don't be concerned about flying in a comparatively small plane. I have been in several choppers, private seaplanes, small commercial planes, private jets, etc. over the years and my flight with WOK was probably the most relaxing, smoothest flight I have had. Credit to Bruce. We all agreed it was like floating on a pillow.

And Bruce's talents are just not as a pilot. As a professional biologist you can absorb an education on the island as you absorb the awesome beauty of the island. Words can't even come close to what your eyes will experience. I found myself quiet, unable to speak, and just trying to capture the moment.

Tripadvisor only has 1 - 5 stars, otherwise I would rate this higher. It is one of the best activities I have taken in all my trips. Be smart, call, make a reservation. Bring a camera, and you can continue to enjoy the beauty for the months after your feet (unfortunately) are back on the ground. But don't look thru the viewfinder, put the camera on automatic and snap away. Don't cheat either of your eyes from a direct view!!

Bruce & WOK, THANKS, I will see you on my next trip for another flight.

Review Title: Kaua'i is such a stunning island!
Review Text:
And Wings Over Kaua'i will take you on a revealing bird's eye view to all of the island's glory!
It was a thrilling experience!

Our pilot was Josh, he was very friendly and informative, very relax and easy going too. Take-off and landing on this small plane is very smooth, if you were to close your eyes you wouldn't be able to tell whether you are on the ground or not.

Our thrill was enhanced because we have been to Kaua'i a few times before, so we had seen a lot of the sights from the ground. It was fabulous to see them from another perspective. Flying close to Mount Waialeale is an inspiring moment, seeing the heart of what created the island millions of years ago. You can not feel anything else but respect for the forces of nature.

We chose this operator because it seems like the small airplanes are less noisy than helicopters, use less fuel and people are simply raving about Wings Over Kaua'i!

Word of advice: if you are a party of four, make sure you are booking the Grand Deluxe Tour, as you'll have the plane for yourselves and will be seated on the right side of the plane where 90% of the views are the best.

We bought the blu-ray version of our flight, the image quality is stunning, plus the recorded discussion really put you back on the mood you were when you took the flight!

Review Text:
This was the best experience we had during on stay on Kauai in August 2014! We had booked this flight many months in advance as this was high on our 'to do' list. It turned out that we were booked on the day that hurricane Iselle was to hit the island. As soon as I heard the timing of the hurricane, I called Wings Over Kauai to see if there was any possibility to be rescheduled. They were very understanding, and moved our flight up to 2 days earlier. We went up on a morning flight and fortunately it turned out to be a beautiful day! We saw incredible views of the island with its many waterfalls. The Napali coast was stunning. As it the summer, we were able to see many sandy beaches and entrances to caves. Our pilot, Josh (if my memory is correct) was extremely knowledgeable and pointed out the different places we were seeing along with some history of the island. The 3 falls of the 'Fantasy Island' falls can only be seen from the air. The aerial view of Waimea Canyon is just beautiful with its colorful red rock mixed with lush green vegetation. After seeing the entire island from an aerial view, it gave us a comparative perspective for seeing the island from a ground level view.

Several people that I have told about this experience have all said that they are 'afraid' to get on a small plane that seats 6-8 people. My husband, daughter (10) and I had never been on a small plane, but it was very smooth and it just felt like we were floating in the air. It was not scary at all! Our pilot had flown with American Airlines and was very experienced. We felt very safe! We purchased a video of our flight (cameras were mounted on the plane's wings) and had fun re-experiencing our adventure on DVD after returning home. You will not be disappointed!

Review Text: My husband, our son and I took the Cessna up with Bruce on Aug 17 for the 70 minute aerial tour of Kauai.  It was a truly amazing flight. We saw parts of Kauai we had never seen before. I only have four stars because our son was the only one on the left side of the plane along with Bruce the pilot and he complained afterwards that he could not see most of the sights very well.  I felt really bad afterwards.  Had I known I would have switched seats with him. Almost all the views were on the right side of the plane so if you ever do this tour make sure you are on the right side.  We also felt a bit queasy after the flight but no one got sick thankfully. Also if you have long legs make sure you are in one of the two back seats. More legroom on those seats.  Big difference between the planes versus the helicopters is the planes are half the cost so if you are on a budget this is a great way to go. Also the helicopters fly into Waimea Canyon but our plane did not.  Bruce was a very informative and friendly your guide. Landing was smooth too.

Review Text:
Awesome service. Our pilot, Bruce, made a point to keep track of all our names and interacted with each of us by name throughout the flight. A very nice touch. We actually flew through some rain (as might be expected as you approach the rainiest mountain on earth) and turbulence didn't get uncomfortable. They had assured us that if they had to cancel due to weather that we would not be charged for the tour at all. It is true that everyone gets a window seat but the nature of an airplane is that it doesn't turn on a dime. They essentially have to choose to go around the island clockwise or counterclockwise. They choose clockwise, so those on the right hand side of the airplane get the best views. If you fill the plane, there will be 2 guests on the right and 4 on the left. They do fly across the middle of the island, turning inland over Poipu going up Waimea Canyon and then out over the ocean for the trip down Na Pali. He does do a full circle over the most beautiful section of Na Pali so everyone on the plane gets a view. He then flies to the left of Ke'e beach and Tunnels then turns inland over Princeville for a nice view of the waterfalls coming off the mountains there. They don't fly as low as helicopters do, but I wonder if helicopters take you over the entire island. (I think they may have to focus on one area or another.)

Overall a great trip for a fraction of the cost of a helicopter trip.

We chose airplane over a boat trip because we feared Captain Andy's from Port Allen would be too choppy and the risk of getting seasick was too high. Also we heard the Port Allen route gives you too short of a visit to the Na Pali coast.

Thanks, Bruce!

Review Text:
We have nothing but good things to say about this outfit.

I tried to book online but everything looked full and I was working on my smartphone which made it difficult. I gave up and called, and Ellen was helpful and patient with me, and let me know how to go about booking.

We got our flight scheduled (for the next day!) and followed the specific driving directions provided on the email confirmation. They took us right where we needed to go, and we were met by a friendly and helpful Bruce, who showed us to the waiting area and gave us some interesting reading material about the island.

Josh, our pilot, then came out to greet us, point out our plane, and let us know they were almost ready for us.

Shortly thereafter Abi greeted us and got us all set up for our flight. She let us know exactly what to expect and answered all of our questions. It turned out I HAD done something wrong trying to book via smartphone but Abi made it no big deal and corrected my error. She was helpful and friendly and then took us out to the plane where she and Josh helped us board.

Josh was great. He was very personable, answered all of our questions, and clearly knows how to pilot a plane. Review Title: Highly recommended...  better than a sunset cruise
Review Text:
So the BF and I were debating whether to view the Na Pali Coast by water or air. I made the executive decision to do both. We did the cheaper sunset cruise with Captain Andy's the night prior. This by far, was a much better, unique experience.

I know most people do the helicopter tours but those were much more expensive and I was wary about riding in a helicopter hovering over places like that and the loud noise. Besides that, this place came highly rated on Trip Advisor so this was the choice for us.

The family that runs this company are very professional and courteous to a T. Upon booking, I think I spoke with Bruce who was super friendly and helpful over the phone. I hung up with a good feeling about them.

We were running slightly late because we took a wrong turn at the airport and had to circle around so they called us just as we were parking the car. Dori was still very nice about it. They called me to the back office and introduced themselves to me, each of the 3 people, shaking my hand. I work in customer service so I make a note to commend them on that.

They gave me a kukui nut lei and a small white flower (I think it was a tuberose) to put in your hair. It smelled wonderful but you can't really wear it on your ear since you have to wear the headphones on the plane so I ended up sticking it in my purse. My boyfriend oddly enough, did not get any gift so I thought that was strange. Another couple was there and the man was wearing the same kukui nut lei I had and the woman had on a different kind. I suspected that they gave it to her but she may have already been wearing one. Anyway, that was the only thing that bothered me about their service. They should equally be accommodating to the males.

I agree with a prior review I read about doing this towards the end of your trip so you can see the places you have been to previously by land. It gives you a better frame of reference and a greater appreciation of this beautiful island. There are no bad seats on the air van. Each seat has its own window. They seat you by weight. My boyfriend sat next to the pilot and I sat directly behind my boyfriend but I was fine with that. They also provide drinks, at least mini water bottles and ginger candies in case you are prone to motion sickness.

The flight itself was outstanding. Our pilot/guide, Josh, was super knowledgeable about everything and even answered all the curious questions we had about various things we saw. The views were spectacularly awesome and they even had a soundtrack during the trip, sometimes corresponding to the view (i.e. - the Jurassic park music). That was a GREAT, very much appreciated touch.

They take photos of you in front of the airplane before you take off and email it to you for free. Make sure the other passengers are not in the back photo-bombing your picture with their legs on the other side of the plane like ours had. They have a video of your specific flight for sale if you want it but they gave us generic one for free! :)

Loved it! A must do!

Review Title: Fantastic flight, great people and the best bang for your buck
Review Text:
We booked Wings Over Kauai as part of a package between them and Blue Dolphin Charters to see Kauai from both sea and air. We did them both the same day, which I'm not sure I'd try again, but we had limited time on the island. The boat tour went about an hour long, so while we did manage to stop by our hotel and change, we were rushing a bit to get to the airport. As it turned out, there was no need to do so. There were two friendly folks there who got us checked in and chit-chatted for a while until the rest of our group arrived. The pilot came out and talked to us, saying weather had come in over the Na Pali coast and that we probably were not going to be able to see it very well. They offered to cancel or re-book our tour, or gave us the option of seeing what we could. Since we had done the boat tour of the Na Pali coast that morning, we decided to go ahead and go up.

It was just me, my husband and another couple (coincidentally also from our boat tour), along with the pilot in the tiny plane. They set us up with water, soda and ginger chews for motion sickness (just in case). We also had noise-canceling headsets and microphones to talk to each other and the pilot during the flight. We ended up seeing almost the entire island and only hit really heavy rain at the end. We were able to see most of the coast, amazing views of Waimea Canyon and the famous waterfall from Jurassic Park, along with lots of other things. The pilot's information was entertaining and interesting, and the musical background was a bit cheesy, but fun and added to the tour.

Overall, I would HIGHLY recommend this. For $225 for the 6-hour boat tour and 90-minute flight it was well worth it. They took our photo in front of the plane before the trip and printed it on a DVD with highlights from the flight (generic, not our specific tour) and gave us that for free at the end of the flight. There was an option to purchase a Blu-ray or DVD of our specific flight, shot from several Go Pro cameras in and outside the plane, but we opted out of that. There was no hard sell. Great people and a great tour!

Our rescheduled tour at the end of our visit was perfect: We got to see where we HAD been during the week, plus all those hidden gems not visible from roads. Review Text:
We travel widely and have gone up in the air in many places including fixed wing in New Zealand (Milford Sound) and in Alaska (Denali, Homer, Ketchikan); rotary wing (helicopter) in New Zealand and Grand Canyon, and hot air balloon in Turkey (Cappadocia).

All have been great experiences.

We rate our trip with Wings over Kauai as one of the best. Our pilot, Josh, on leave from American Eagle, was terrific, as was his wife Dori, who is in the office. Owner Bruce was welcoming.

Josh was knowledgable, caring, attentive, and safe.

Remember, 80% of Kauai is inaccessible on the ground. The only way to see it is from the air.

I realize that helicopters are now the rage, but we were the only passengers in the fixed wing Cessna 172; we burned 25% of the fuel; and both had window seats. Plus it costs half or less.

Wings offers a tour for two that we took. They also offer a tour in a larger plane that costs slightly less. For us, the decision was easy.

BTW, if you want the personalized video of your trip, make sure to order it before or immediately after the flight. We waited until the next day and the video files had been erased. NOTE: there are several GoPros in and around the plane that capture your experience.

Review Title: This is the must do activity for Kauai
Review Text:
There's a reason Wings Over Kauai Air Tours is the # 1 rated activity for Kauai. My wife and I recently returned from our 2nd visit to Kauai. Having been stationed on Oahu and trained on the Big Island, I can say Kauai is the most beautiful Hawaiian Island. Wings Over Kauai is the BEST method to see the landscape. During our most recent visit, we took my wife's parents and her older brother. The hour long air tour was the highlight of our group's excursions.

We booked the one hour Air Van Private Charter, and Josh was our pilot / guide while airborne. Dori, Ellen and Millie (the owner's dog) greeted us at the hangar that is shared with several smaller air tour operators. The easiest route to their hangar is drive towards LIH (Lihue airport), pass the curbside pick up and drop off and you'll see the fixed wing hangar less than a mile on the right side. Keep LIH runways on your right side, and you'll see the Wings Over Kauai signage. Check-in consists of weigh-ins for aircraft balance, a model of Kauai to point out routes (each dependent on weather), and addressing any concerns passengers have pre-flight. Once check-in was complete, we had ample time to use restrooms on site and view aircraft departing and arriving into LIH.

Prior to boarding the aircraft, a group photo was taken plane side. GoPro cameras are mounted to each wing and at least one interior camera faces passengers. My wife was given a Kukui nut necklace for the photos and as a gift. Once on board, BOSE two-way headphones are given to each passenger for communication with your pilot and each other. For airplane enthusiasts such as myself, you'll enjoy hearing ATC and other aircraft in the area during the flight. I really liked this feature as you'll quickly notice all the aircraft circling Kauai are constantly in radio contact and sharing information regarding weather or terrain features. A cooler with refreshments and snacks is also provided in the cabin, a nice touch. Highlights of our flight included two whale pods sighted on windward side of the island, breathtaking views inside Waimea Canyon and the beach views from 5,000 feet. We even passed over our condo in Princeville and took photographs to share with future renters, review forthcoming.

Total airtime was over 60 minutes, and the blend of Josh's commentary and background music was perfect. Everyone on board had questions for Josh, and he did a great job explaining the island's legends, culture and environment. As we taxied back to the hangar, a DVD or BluRay copy of your flight is offered. The 3 GoPro cameras capture everything you saw during the flight, and interior commentary is optional. Dori gave us a CD with their promotional video and the cover included one of our group's pre-flight photos. Ten minutes after we landed, my smartphone showed an e-mail from Wings Over Kauai with five group photographs Dori took. Customer service is above and beyond at Wings Over Kauai.

Why Wings Over Kauai Air Tours vs. helicopters or other guides? The seating is spacious, and you have more flexibility in where you can place passengers. All passengers have a port and starboard window. Driving into Waimea Canyon doesn't guarantee a view, we've made that drive before. My mother-in-law opted out of the flight just prior to departure. The ground crew never made her feel guilty and were supportive of her decision. You cover more airspace vs. the helicopter tours, and you literally fly above them. The tour is priced extremely well, and environmental impact is low. Don't hesitate to call or e-mail Wings Over Kauai for assistance in planning. This is the must do activity for Kauai! Mahalo Wings Over Kauai!

Review Text:
My girlfriend and I had our Hawaii vacation planned for almost six months. The #1 activity we wanted to do was a flight over the island. Months of research, countless hours of reading reviews, and we both agreed on Wings Over Kauai.

We just completed our tour yesterday, February 18, 2014, and the experience was amazing. My girlfriend described it as the single-most amazing experience she has ever had, so the bar is set very high now. I have to agree with her too.

Before I get into the actual flight experience, I need to mention to staff. The staff was extremely kind, friendly, and helpful. They answered all of our questions in a friendly manner each time we called. Also, even after our flight, they told us to call for any questions we may have on anything we may have such where to eat, other activities, if we get lost etc. Really? Who offers that anymore? But they offered and you could see they genuinely cared.

Now for the flight...WOW. That pretty much sums it up. Every second something else just stood out as beautiful. I cannot state if every flight is the same comfort level, but our flight was extremely smooth and very little bumbs. Bruce was our pilot on the private two-person Cessna. He was extremely informative and extremely courteous to our needs. Besides seeing waterfalls everywhere, we happened to come across a whale. I saw the whale and mentioned it, he then took a few moments to guide the plane closer to it so we could get a better picture. As he did that, the whale breached, which apparently does not happen to often to see from the plane. It looked just like a Pacific Life commercial, but it was all while flying.

So my recommendation is to go ahead and book this; you will be happy you did. The cost of the trip is extremely reasonable and the memories are a lifetime.

Review Text: I booked a flight lesson/tour in a Cessna 172 for my girlfriend and myself. I basically booked a flight lesson just so that I can fly myself (I’m a pilot), but the flight was essentially a tour. However, Bruce was great; he was patient, friendly and informative about flying in Hawaii, so I also learned quite a bit. I was on the controls from the time we started taxing for departure until we parked the plane, so in that respect the flight was a real lesson. My girlfriend, who was in the back seat and is not an aviation enthusiast at all, enjoyed the flight as much as I did. I highly recommend flying with Bruce if you are a pilot. The opportunity to fly in Hawaii is not something that us mainlanders get every day, and the cost is not much more than a flight lesson in a comparable airplane on the mainland. The views however are certainly something I don’t get while flying in Pennsylvania. If I ever make it back to Kauai, I will definitely book another flight. Review Text:

Review Text:
Quick info about us: We are a family of four, husband and wife for 16+ years and twins (boy and girl born in 2001). Our daughter is the social butterfly, our son has autism (he is non-verbal, but loving and happy). Our travels are interesting because they always have the perspective of a family with a special needs child as a part of them.

Having been to Kauai twice before, we were debating what to do for our final hurrah of this trip with our kids. The trip had been beyond fantastic for our family after a long and stressful year. Since we have taken boat trips to tour the Na'pali Coast twice before, we wanted to do something different. We narrowed it down to an ATV tour, a helicopter tour, or the Wings over Kauai tour. I like to email companies before signing up to explain our son's autism and to share our uncertainties on how he will handle certain activities. This helps me both get more information and also hear the heart of the company's response. Wings over Kauai began to win hands down right off the bat with Ellen's thoughtful and kind emails. You don't know how heart warming it is to have compassionate people communicate to you when you are vulnerable about your child's special needs! Even though we doubted how good an hour flight could be, we decided to choose Wings over Kauai based on three things: 1. Ellen's emails. 2. Tripadvisor's reviews. 3. Affordable price. It was the best decision we made amongst a two week string of great experiences!

When we arrived, the staff (Ellen, Ellen's daughter and a friend, and Bruce) all greeted us warmly and were delightfully personal and friendly. After a review of procedures and our tour, we were raring to go. By this point our son had seen the airplanes taking off and landing and was getting very happy and excited that we were going to go on one! Josh, our pilot, talked with us before we boarded (we got the family photo as well), and we loaded up in a way that seemed to work best. We left our son's microphone unplugged in case he got worked up, but left it to where he could hear us. Again, to have people concerned about your son is a huge blessing, and we felt that they went above and beyond to care.
The flight itself was everything people here have said. It gave us a whole new perspective of the island and it's beauty and made us love it all the more. Josh was the perfect host with lots of information and stories and insight that added great depth to the experience. He was very personal and by the end of the tour it felt like we were lifelong friends. The island itself is the most beautiful place I've been, and this tour showed off that beauty tremendously.

When the flight was over we felt that it was just the right amount of time, but also felt that we could take the tour over and over again just because it was so beautiful and informative. We took one last picture and our boy had a huge grin on his face. We were given the complimentary dvd and it was great to have such a personal touch of having our photo on it.

Since it has been 8 months since our adventure, I can still say this is a memory we are glad we made. Our son (now thirteen) still often pulls up the picture of the Wings over Kauai plane and points to it (his way of asking to go again). I agree buddy, I agree!

Review Title: An unforgettable experience with so much personal touch and care
Review Text:
Aufgrund der TOP Bewertungen auf tripadvisor haben wir als besonderes Highlight auf Kauai den Rundflug gebucht und Wings Over Kauai Air Tours ist zu Recht die Nr. 1 – auch für uns.
Ich könnte mir kein besseres Preis-Leistungsverhältnis vorstellen und oben drauf ein herzlicher und persönlicher Kontakt.
Schon die Buchung war völlig problemlos, ich bekam schnell die Bestätigung per E-Mail sowie alle wichtigen Informationen zu Treffpunkt, Transfer, exakter Flugzeit usw.
Wir wurden pünktlich am ABC Store abgeholt, was wirklich nur einen kurzen Spaziergang vom Hafen, wo unser Kreuzfahrtschiff lag, entfernt war, alternativ gibt es auch einen kostenfreien Shuttle bis dahin.
Bei Ankunft am Flughafen wurden wir auch sofort sehr herzlich und namentlich begrüßt. Wir wurden mit allen wichtigen Informationen für den Flug versorgt, bekamen noch ein kleines hawaiianisches Gastgeschenk und durften im Wartebereich Platz nehmen, bis es los ging.
Vor dem Einsteigen in den Flieger wurde ein Foto von uns gemacht, das wir noch am selben Tag per E-Mail kostenfrei gesendet bekamen und im Anschluss an den Flug abgedruckt auf einer CD mit tollen Impressionen – auch diese kostenfrei.
Außer uns 3 Erwachsenen war ein weiteres Ehepaar an Bord. Es gab eine Kühlbox an Bord mit verschiedenen Getränken, falls man durstig werden sollte – auch im Preis inklusive. Wir hatten gar keine Gelegenheit, Durst zu verspüren, da ein atemberaubender Flug über eine traumhafte Landschaft auf uns wartete. Jeder hatte Kopfhörer mit integriertem Mikrofon, so dass wir mit dem Piloten und allen anderen kommunizieren konnten. Das Wetter war SUPER und so hatten wir beste Sicht auf alles, was auf uns wartete, sogar Wale, die sich vor der Küste Kauais im Wasser tummelten. Wir bekamen sehr viele Informationen, Fragen wurden kompetent beantwortet und es war ein mehr als gelungener Ausflug.
Zurück am Boden begleitete uns der Pilot zurück zum Counter. Er informierte uns, dass der gesamte Flug dank der Videokameras aufgezeichnet wurde und wir uns auf Wunsch den Film auf DVD zusenden lassen könnten gegen einen wirklich geringen Aufpreis – selbstverständlich nahmen wir das Angebot an und der Versand – selbst hierher nach Deutschland – war kein Problem. So haben wir eine wundervolle Erinnerung, die wir jederzeit auffrischen und wieder und wieder die wundervolle Natur Kauai's aus der Vogelerspektive genießen können.
Thank you SO much for an unforgettable experience Wings Over Kauai Air Tours – a perfect add to my mum's 60th birthday that day!

Review Title: Highlight of our trip to Hawaii
Review Text:
Just returned from a trip to Hawaii. We did several amazing activities including swimming with sharks on the North Shore of Oahu with Hawaii Shark Encounters, driving the entire Road to Hana in a rental car using the Gypsy Guide Road to Hana app, and doing a whale watching tour on a raft with the Pacific Whale Foundation. Each of those were great and could have been the highlight of our trip but the best thing we did was our flight with Wings Over Kauai.

Arranging the trip on line with Ellen was easy. We were able to reserve the whole plane for our group at the internet rate. Once at the airport, the check in process was quick and easy, even the dreaded weigh-in was handled with discretion and was painless. Our pilot, Josh was incredible and very engaging.

The views were fantastic. Much of what we saw was on private land and only viewable from the air. Highlights included the Na Pali coast, Waimea Canyon and the valley and waterfall featured in Jurassic Park. We had driven up through Waimea Canyon the day before and it was interesting to see the same views from the air that we saw from the ground.

The flight was smooth, everyone had an unobstructed view and headsets so we could hear Josh and each other's comments. There was even a coordinated musical soundtrack.

We were on a cruise and Ellen picked us up from a shopping center near the cruise port and returned us to the ship.

We were offered a video of our flight for purchase and given a generic video and our photograph in front of the plane for free.

It was a first class experience the whole way. Couldn't have been happier. Big thanks to Ellen and Josh.

Review Title: Most bang for your buck, Wonderful Route, Great People and Beautiful Island
Review Text:
We were on the Norwegian Cruise Line Hawaiian trip. The ship stopped at Kauai for two days. The helicopter ride ship was promoting costs around $350 per person. Since I have a group of 6 with varying budgets, I Tripadvisored and found Wings Over Kauai. For the whole 6-seater plane and an hour long tour, it costed us a little more than $500 after taxes in TOTAL. And it was basically a private tour.

The flying route will take you to all of the main attractions on the island of Kauai. Na Pali Coast, the Waimea Canyon and all the wonderful waterfalls, etc. We were very lucky with the weather, so the oldest of Hawaiian Islands, Kauai was completely revealed to us. After seeing most of the main islands, I have to say it is the most beautiful in my eyes.

But, really it is the people of Wings Over Kauai that truly made this tour so special. Started from the booking, planning, pick-up and finally the tour itself, everyone involved was courteous and very helpful. Ellen handled most of the pre-flight arrangement, she knows about our ship better than I did. As it was to leave earlier than I thought I would on the day of the trip. And most of all, Josh our pilot, was really knowledgable and have this genuine friendliness about him that just made all of us enjoyed our trip so much more. The fact he speaks some Chinese and good looking just made my mom and all of her friends felt very much "at ease" (they were really worried about the size of the plane when I told them about the tour). They ended up spending all of the preflight time chatting and teasing Josh and totally forgot about their initial worries (it went so bad as one of them was asking if he'd like to be set up for a date with her daughter. at which point I had to intervene :). Since he use to be a commercial pilot for the American Airline, he handled our 6-seaters with ease and professional smoothness. Even my partner who usually gets really nauseated with a small plane, barely had any problems this time. And the landing was very smooth, I clapped. As a tour guide, Josh was equally up to the task. One thing I really loved, he had different the background music ready when flying over different locations.

All in all I thoroughly enjoyed the tour, it was hands down the least expensive and the most exciting tour we did on the whole Hawaiian tour.

Couple of tips:
1)Book ahead, if possible with a group of 5-6 or 2 for the whole plane (they also have a two-seater). Otherwise, it's $125 per person as of Nov. 2013.
2)For pickup, ask for the Pier if possible. Although their pickup spot isn't too far from the Pier, it's about 5-10 mins walk and has a convenient store there that sells much cheaper items than the ship store.
3)The only downside with the plane tour is, maybe with a helicopter you can get closer to the scenic location. However at triple the price, I wonder it would be worth it any more.

Review Text:

Unfortunately I got sick towards the end of the flight and had to use the "aloha bag" as they call it. Helpful hint: if you're about to get sick, point the microphone AWAY from you before you hurl. We paid about $250 total for two people, not including tip. There are definitely cheaper alternatives out there but remember, they are rated No. 1 on Trip Advisor for a reason. If you are looking to splurge on a single excursion, this is definitely it.

Review Text:
My wife is not a good flyer, even on a 767, let alone a little Cessna or the like. There was no way I could get her on a helicopter tour, so the doors off experience wasn't going to happen. So I read to her very carefully, the reviews on the stability of WOK's Australian built plane, the safety etc, but she still wasn't having a bar of it. So I did what any good husband would, I booked it anyway.
So, one or two days prior, she began to go quiet and on the day of the flight, she couldn't even talk to our pilot, who was doing his best to appease her, but clearly failing. The only thing left was to just get her in the plane and do it.
Well, the flight was faultless, hardly a bump, even when warned of certain areas that may cause a bit of turbulence. The scenery is spectacular, the commentary informative, with an open mic if you want to ask anything at all.
I recommend you do this straight up, and then spend the rest of the time relaxing. We drove around a bit, hiked, but the view is unrivalled from the air. Don't miss this, as only 15 or 20% of Kauai is accessible by road. It is The best way to see the NaPali coastline. We hiked up the Kalalau trail from Ke'e Beach on a very calm day and watched as the Catamarans and Rafts bounced and bounced all the way down the coast. We were so glad we cancelled our plans to "sail" down the coastline. It looked liked a bumper car ride. And I really don't know how you could get the same perspective as from the air. A lot of bouncing to zip through a couple of sea caves I think.
Plus, at the end, you can order a copy of your flight, recorded in 1080HD, complete with all your audio too, for $30. Great value. It costs about that for two digital photos off a Disneyland Ride doesn't it. And don't worry about the clouds. We went on a very cloudy day, which it always seems to be, but saw everything, but the top of the peak of course. Great value. Book it now.

Review Text:
My boyfriend and I experienced more of Kaua'i during our hour with Bruce than in our four days on the island. We took the Wings Over Kaua'i flight on our first day, so the overview gave us a good idea of how we wanted to spend our remaining time.

Pros follow:

*Private tour in a four-seater propeller plane (Bruce, the boyfriend, me)
*Boyfriend (as "co-pilot") ticked off pre-take-off checklist as we watched an American Airlines plane depart before us
*Bruce smoothly handled the plane, so we didn't experience any motion sickness
*As we circled the island, Bruce listed the places we could explore during our time on Kaua'i (e.g. Anini Beach, a lagoon like spot), which was materially more efficient than reading a travel guide
*Views of waterfall after waterfall that are unaccessible except by air

This tour was really good value, and I appreciated the funds go to a mom-and-pop business operated by people passionate about Kaua'i. Frankly, $125 per person is a steal, and I'd recommend this tour without reservation to any of my friends heading to the "Garden Island."

Review Text:
After reviewing a number of air charters, we chose Wings Over Kauai based primarily on the Number 1 rating here at TA, plus the excellent reviews from previous customers. It is also cheaper - by half, at least - than a helicopter tour (for the same 60-75 minute tour), and if you are eco-minded, apparently the fixed-wing aircraft of Wings uses much less fuel than a copter. Though it seems that all the companies offering air tours have terrific safety records, it is also my belief that fixed-wing aircraft are generally safer than helicopters. We are joining with all those who have given Wings an excellent rating with no hesitation, and provide our recommendation with great enthusiasm!
From the moment we arrived at the airport, we were made to feel welcome and at ease, should we have had any anxiety. We conversed with the receptionist, who was the owner's daughter, and she was terrific. She handled the few administrative details with efficiency and again, made us feel extremely comfortable. She also took our photo before we boarded the plane, which was much appreciated.
Our flight had another couple, and all four of us had window seats (all the seats are window seats, but based on the flight of the aircraft, it appears that you may have better views of things by being seated on the right side of the airplane, as we all were able/instructed to do). Water and soda was available if you wanted it, as well as some remedies for motion sickness, if the need arose (my wife actually felt a little queasy during a portion of the flight and took one of the lozenges provided, which made her feel fine almost immediately).
I have flown in helicopters several times (all for work) and never in a small plane, so I was anxious to compare the distinctions between the experiences. I was immediately struck by the smoothness and quality of the flight, even in some mild turbulence. Our pilot was extremely knowledgeable and friendly, and something about his manner in the airplane exuded confidence (which is important in a pilot!).
The views from the airplane were simply amazing. The mountains, beaches, canyons, waterfalls, and caves were astounding in their beauty and ruggedness. The view of developed properties (e.g., golf courses, plantations, hotels/resorts) was also outstanding. The flight path covered nearly the whole island (I am not sure why about 1/4 [-less? Generally, from east of Princeville to Lihue] of the island is not on the tour) and flew over all the spots you would care to see. Be prepared to take many, many photos, of course (One slight negative regarding this concerns the fact that you are taking your pictures out of a window - the views you get through the window are amazing, but some photos are subject to get a little glare - not the fault of Wings; just be aware of this).
Once we landed, we were given a copy of a DVD which highlighted the views we experienced during the flight (these are "stock" clips, but still provide a nice memento of the trip - the cover of the DVD is one of the photos taken of you before you board the plane). Later that evening, the owners contacted us via email to thank us and encourage our review on TA (a nice touch!).
We met another couple at a luau a couple days later who had flown with Wings a day after we did. They flew when there was much more rain in the mountains, so they shared how the pilot stated they were seeing more waterfalls than were present in the days beforehand. I mention this to say that I don't think weather will likely stop your flight (this is up to Wings, but I think it likely that you will encounter rain at some point during the flight - this was no problem and didn't really diminish the quality of photos that we took).
It seems that all the travel folks recommend seeing Kauai by air during your visit. I think this is a valid recommendation, and I can say with no reluctance that you will not be disappointed by booking with Wings Over Kauai.

On the plane, there's a supply of water, peppermints and ginger, and an "aloha bag" (in the event of airsickness). However, Josh's expert piloting skills ensured us a smooth and easy ride and no one on our tour needed it.

The approximately 1 hour tour gave us a spectacular aerial view of the coastline and familiar sites of Kauai, including, among others, the Waimea Canyon, the Na Pali Coast, waterfalls, and a number of film locations. On our tour, we also happened upon multiple rainbows from the air, including an almost 360 degree rainbow - quite the sight to see. Josh provided friendly, informative, and interactive commentary that also catered to our individual interests. At the end of the tour, we received complimentary photos that Dori had taken of us alongside the plane.

This tour is outstanding and great value. We highly recommend it.

First off, the couple who runs this place is extremely nice. We had a reservation for an afternoon tour, got there, and they said that due to weather conditions, they could bring us on a short tour, but we wouldn't be able to see most of the island because the clouds were so low, so they let us reschedule and let us know that if things weren't better, they'd give us a call so we wouldn't have to make the trip out.

The day of the tour, thankfully, was nice just when we were ready to go out and the views are seriously breathtaking.

Scared of getting into such a small plan? I kind of was. The pilot is also an American airlines pilot, and the flight was incredibly smooth. The take off and landing in the small plan were really fun, and the ride was pretty much turbulent free. They even provide drinks AND blankets to make the trip that much more enjoyable.

You all get to wear headphones so that you can talk to one another over the sound of the engine and the pilot is super knowledgeable about a ton of fun facts about the island. There's also music in the background that will keep you entertained throughout the trip through paradise.

I know it's a pretty penny to be spending, but if you're going to Kauai, you don't want to miss this!

Review Text:
Given the support already on TA, this may seem like piling on but...no problem, lets pile! We have been not quite annual visitors to Kauai for many years and thought we knew the place pretty well. One thing we had never done was a helicopter or fixed wing tour. Should have done it way earlier, and this is definitely the way to do it.

We met Bruce the day before after a long day (his) but he was friendly and enthusiastic. Happy to talk about what WOK had to offer and talk about how that fit in with our hopes and expectations. We signed up for a C172 flight the next day.

Everyone has the same island to display (about which more later.) What was truly wonderful about Bruce, Sherry and the team is that this was a personal thing that, within the limits of what was possible, was the product of getting what we wanted done. I have spent a lot of time flying so I wanted to do a bit of hands on stuff but didn't want to miss all the sightseeing opportunities. No problem. Bruce was happy to fly the airplane when I wanted to sightsee and let me fly when I felt the itch. He is an instructor as well as a tour pilot so he can give a lesson along with the tour if anyone wants that.

Since we had been to Kauai many times, we also didn't need the pitch about "on your right you can see Poipu" etc. but we were very interested in information about places that are hard or impossible to get to on the ground. Bruce had all that at his fingertips along with a lot of fascinating stuff from his days as an agronomist on the island.

Bruce is fully capable of flying the standard tour and giving the standard spiel to first time, non-pilot visitors but he is also comfortable with adapting that baseline approach to whatever the customer actually would like. And that is what is truly neat about WOK. You don't feel like you are a participant in a script someone wrote ages ago and no one can vary from. It's more like a nice plane trip with a friend.

Josh and Sherry are from the same mould. They are friendly, helpful and anxious to do whatever they can to provide a memorable experience. When we got there, they were trying to sort out the larger plane which had booked one couple that was going to be a few minutes late and another who had to get back to their cruise ship immediately after an on time flight. They ended up moving the late couple to the next flight taking the time-constrained couple on a personal tour in the large airplane. A lot of companies would not do that!

In the meantime, Bruce escorted us to our small, "personalized" Cessna and we took off.

The fact that Kauai is one of the world's truly beautiful places was not news to us but the flight allowed us to experience it in an entirely new way. Trails we had hiked were now visible from above, as were dive sites that I had been to many times. It is just amazing to see the reef formations from a different perspective. They are beautiful up close but also beautiful in an entirely different way from 2,000 ft. The Napali coast is spectacular from the trail and from the ocean but present a whole new aspect from above (and beside.) Valleys that you basically can't get into at all on the ground are laid out below in awesome splendor. This is an experience not to be missed and that is true if this is your twentieth or your first and only visit to Kauai. We will add the memories to our Kauai databank and cherish them for a long time.

I have not done the helicopter tour so I can't really compare them but I was completely satisfied with the fixed wing experience. That is without regard to the price difference, which I am told is considerable. Since I would gladly have paid twice what we did for the experience, price was not a driver for us. We saw everything that was there to see and did it in the context of a friendly, personalized experience that we will remember with great fondness.

The other 1100 reviewers are dead on!

Review Title: Wings Over Kauai - Book it for sure!
Review Text:
Soaring over the island of Kauai with my boyfriend and Bruce, owner/pilot of Wing's Over Kauai, totally made my day.

We hit the jack pot -- we were the only ones who signed up for the 2:30 p. m. slot, so Bruce was our very own private tour guide.

Bruce took us up in his 4 seater Cessna. I've never ridden in such a small plane, but Bruce made us feel comfortable right off the bat.

We were up in the air before we knew it. What really impressed me about Bruce was his confidence and his concern for safety. There happened to be another tour company flying at the same time as we were and that pilot flew dangerously close to the Na Pali Coast mountains. Bruce made a comment that he would not do that, and that made me feel so much better.

There is nothing like the colors that you see on the island from the air. You can see why Kauai is called the Garden Isle. The hills and valleys were a vibrant green and the ocean shimmered a lovely turquoise. The Na Pali coast and Waimea Canyon was a sight to see, it was beautiful.

What was really fun was seeing those sights we had driven to on previous days. For us, Hanalei Beach was one of them. There's no mistaking Hanalei Bay with the half moon stretch of beach. Bruce pointed out many more pristine beaches to us that we will visit for sure the next time we are on Kauai.

Bruce was the best. So informative, so funny (he told some corny jokes too) and so endearing.

By the way, I have taken the helicopter tour before (about 10 years ago), but I enjoyed the Wings Over Kauai flight much better. The first reason is I got a little nauseous on the helicopter due to their quick maneuvers. I didn't get sick at all with the plane ride with Bruce. The second reason is the helicopter tour boasts about taking you closer to the action, but to me I'd rather fly with someone like Bruce who is concerned about the safety of his passengers.

If you get the chance, do take the flight with Wings Over Kauai. It made for a memorable end to our vacation.

A. Nakamura and M. Harris

Wings Over Kauai offers a comfortable air tour of the entire island with spectacular views of the most popular and breathtaking sites the island has to offer, including: waterfalls, coastlines, Waimea Canyon, the inner island, sugar plantations, resort areas, and open sea.

On our last trip, we were thrilled to see several pods of whales swimming in the open sea from the air. Incredible! Throughout the ride, you'll hear about the island (including some history) from the friendly pilot through noise-cancelling headphones. The plane is small, carrying only about 8 passengers and they are always on time with their flights. Be aware that harsh weather will sometimes interrupt the tours, so it's a good idea to call ahead if the weather looks ominous. The flight leaves from the Lihue airport - very easy to find their hanger, just past the main terminal.

The plane tours offer a much more affordable way to see the island, as opposed to the helicopter ventures. Wings Over Kauai also gifts you with a lovely DVD as a thank you gift for taking their flight. My spouse and I will be watching our videos (both theirs and those that we took in flight) many times to remember this special trip. Highly recommended.

Review Text:
This review is for the Grand Deluxe tour with Kauai by Air. The tour covers most of the standard spots in Kauai including Jurassic Falls, Napali, Waimea Canyon, etc.

Experience (5/5) - The experience was amazing at every customer touch-point. Our initial conversation during the data gathering and reservation was candid, honest and direct without any high-pressure sales. This is followed by the first in-person conversation where they Bruce and Ellen warmly invited us into their office to collect additional information and address other flying logistics, rather than dealing with the customer at the counter. They are also well prepared with some interesting reading materials while the customers wait for the plane logistics to work out. The actual flying experience is amazing as well. Bruce is a very good pilot and guide who immerses you in the overall flying experience. He's extremely knowledgeable and beyond pointing the standard spots he understands Kauai's vegetation very well (he used to be an agro-scientist before). Finally, at exit they awarded us with a CD that had one of their tours on a bright & sunny day.

Pricing (5/5) - Fly by Kauai has one price, that is honored any way you contact them. This makes shopping far more easier. While doing our research, we came across groups that would change the price depending on the discount coupon/magazine you're holding.

Ethics (5/5) - I felt it was important to highlight this category because I've read nightmare experiences across some other reviews across their competition in Helicopter and Air. The case in point is where the second group did not show up due to a scheduling error. Bruce came by to tell us that they will need to change planes because the # of passengers had reduced. Unfortunately, their smaller plane did not have enough fuel and since it would take more time to refuel the plane they took us flying in the original larger plane, at the expense of their profit. A lesser group would have delayed the trip or made us wait longer till the smaller plane was refueled.

One other aspect I want to highlight is for people that get motion sick easily. I am one of those who feels nausea after an hour long boat ride. Given that, an Airplane ride is a safer choice rather than a helicopter ride as they tend to change altitude much more rapidly. So for all of you who get motion sick easily, I would recommend that you go for a plane tour. Note that this does not guarantee that you will not get motion sick, but it reduces the possibility.

Review Title: A highlight of your vacation that will provide fabulous photo memories!
Review Text:
We looked into doing a helicopter ride over Kauai, but while doing internet research, I came across 'Wings Over Kauai'. The reviews and the price seemed favorable and since we'd previously experienced a helicopter ride (on the Big Island), we decided to give the small plane a whirl. We were not disappointed!

We booked the flight a few weeks prior to our visit to Kauai in December 2012. 'Wings Over Kauai' has a convenient check-in desk at Lihue Airport where you check in with the friendly staff, go over some brief paperwork and then wait a short while in the small airport lounge where there are toilets available.

Josh, our pilot introduced himself and was bursting with friendly 'Aloha' spirit and confidence! We boarded the plane, where we got a complimentary bottle of water. We took off and as the runway disappeared behind us, the adventure began!

While in the plane, you wear headphones with a mic attached, through which you can hear the pilot's running commentary about what you're seeing. You can also ask questions and make comments that everyone in the plane can hear.

Have your long camera lenses ready for the stunning views as you see miles of coastline, blue waters, waterfalls, coffee groves, fancy resorts, celebrity houses, an Indian temple, the cruise port, the Na Pali coast, Waimea Canyon and possibly even whales.

It's a thrilling approximately 60 minute ride that will leave you on a high for a few days and provide you with some fabulous photo memories.

You are given a complimentary previously filmed short DVD as a keepsake of the trip and they e-mail you a digital photo of yourself next to the plane.

For $125 per person, it beat the price of the much more expensive helicopter rides and yet still provided one of the absolute highlights of our vacation. We recommend it!

NOTE: Complimentary parking available in front of the check-in terminal.
It's recommended you book the flight early in your vacation in case it has to be postponed due to weather conditions. We were lucky to have a beautiful clear day!

Review Title: Wings over Kauai - personal tour in Cessna
Review Text:
I was looking for something different to do while visiting Kauai'i for a meeting, so I looked about and ended up booking a tour via their website. Ellen got back to me not long after to confirm details. Very easy booking process, very friendly. Being a flight sim geek when i found out they could do a personal cessna flight with 'stick' time I had to jump at that chance! So I booked a personal flight in their Cessna (turned into an introductory flying lesson) which was excellent - so much so I bought a trainee pilot log book and booked another flight/lesson later that week!! The typical tours are in their larger Air-caravan with other people - i poked my head in it in the hangar while it was being maintained, looks like everyone gets a great view in comfort. (my second flight was at the end of day so ended at the hangar - so looks like they maintain their aircraft frequently. Interestingly Bruce asked me if it was ok if we taxied to the hangar - nice touch incase I was in a hurry), On both days while waiting for the Cessna, I saw people come off the Air-van and heard them all raving about how much they loved it etc.

The cessna is great for a personal/couples flight, and based on what i paid for a personal 1.1 hour flight/lesson in the Cessna, it was very reasonable indeed compared to a shared helicopter tour (i paid a bit over $200 for each personal flight/lesson of 1.1 hrs all the way round the island which is amazing value for what is effectively instructor time, hire of cessna and fuel - and I could have brought a guest along with me for no extra cost....). Granted a heli tour will get you a bit closer to the sights, but if you are looking for a very nice way to view all the sights of the island without the hairiness you will get from a helicopter tour, fly with this company. Even if you are zoned on a helicopter flight, take a tour with Bruce as well as you will get at least an hour to see the entire island (empty your camera's memory card!) at a leisurely pace with interesting commentary as well.

It is clear Bruce and Ellen love what they do, and Bruce was a very good tour guide with a background in agriculture on island prior to starting this company. Bruce was also a very good instructor - clear instructions, subtle assistance (or clear assitance where needed) and very informative incase anyone is looking to log some hours or just give it a try - cant think of anywhere better to do your first lessons, it is a stunnning island and the cessna seemed to be in very good condition. I am now begging my wife to allow me to continue lessons back home....

Very highly recommended.

The flight lasted about an hour and was an incredible value, especially considering you can't get to most of the places we were able to see from the air, what a beautiful island!

Josh is incredibly knowledgable about Kauai and the Hawaiian islands, in addition to being a terrific pilot. All of the seats in their Gippsland G8 AirVan have active noise cancelling headsets, which made talking to each other and listening to Josh really easy(not the case in many small aircraft). Although a fixed wing airplane can't fly quite as close to some of the canyons as the helicopters, everyone gets a window seat(many helicopters are 3-4 across).

Ellen took a beautiful photo of us next to the plane, emailed it too us, and gave us a DVD with a short video montage from previous flights set to music. Overall a fantastic experience!

FYI, although we didn't do it, if you're a pilot and want hands on flying they can do a lesson in their Cessna 172.

Review Text:
I am going to write a big review as Wings over Kauai deserves it.

Background:
This is a must for any trip to Kauai. Choices are either a chopper or an air tour. The air tour is by far the most bang for your buck. For air tour we were on smaller Cesna so we were the only ones with our pilot - Josh, this is a great option for privacy and you get personal attention from the Pilot - I got to be the co-pilot :-). You can also choose a big 6 seater Airvan, which has larger windows but more passengers with you.
Tip: Sit on the right side of the plane.

Service:
Ellen was super courteous and made sure we had all the information about choices that we had. The lady at the reception (can't remember her name) was good too and did all the formalities. This process takes ~10minutes.
Tip: Try to book at least 4 days in advance.
Our pilot - Josh was brilliant and made sure this was a perfect way to say "Mahalo!!" to Kauai. He is extremely courteous and knowledgeable about the island. He made sure that we had every opportunity to photographs amazing vistas - he did double rounds over some waterfalls. The good thing about Cesna is that you get undivided attention of the pilot.
Many thanks to Josh.
They take your photos (and email them to you) before boarding on the plane and do a great job of tucking you nicely. I was the co-pilot, so i had an opportunity to see all the controls apart from enjoying the views. You get noise cancelling headphone so that you can communicate with each other and the pilot. They also give you a free pre-made DVD (not of your actual flight). It is a 5 minute DVD with music encapsulating the tour.
Tip: The photography buff should sit on the back seat as there is a bar blocking good photography over the front seat side windows.

Flight:
Our flight was around ~65 minutes. The flight started from Lihue commuter's airport terminal. The path started from the south-east corner of the island through Poipu beach, port Allen - into the center of the island Waimea canyon with all the waterfalls - into the north-west corner Napali coast and all amazing vistas - onto north-east side and finally back to the airport. The views are simply breath taking and no review can do justice for this experience. So you have to experience it yourself.

Bottom Line:
I would give A+ to Wings over Kauai for the price ($125/person) and the over all flight experience. You can choose a chopper ride that will cost you 2X ($250/person), the only plus on the chopper ride is that they can land you on some waterfalls which are otherwise inaccessible and can fly little close to the mountains. To me i wanted to get the big picture so flying close to mountains would make sense. However, both options are good.

Thank you WINGS OVER KAUAI for making this a memorable trip.

Review Title: Spectacular, Friendly, Adaptive and Personal Experience,  The best part of our visit to Kawai!
Review Text:
