Review Title: Great day. Great weather. Great pictures. Great people.  So ... DO IT!
Review Text:
This was our third trip to Hawaii, and second to Kauai. Last time here we took the helicopter tour & thought it was great. This time we decided to fly again, but wanted a better opportunity for photography. We reviewed all the brochures, but Wings Over Kauai was the only one that offered open-window capabilities. We're also very environmentally sensitive about any place we go (yes, we pick up other people's trash), and liked the idea that the plane used so much less fuel than a chopper. That settled it! Pilot Bruce and his wife Ellen welcomed us warmly with a Plumeria flower for my hair and a Kukui nut lei. There was a cooler in the back with water and soda at no charge. My husband is the photographer in the family, so I opted for the back seat, although photo ops from that viewpoint were also possible through the open window. The Bose noise-cancelling headphones were fantastic, and we were able to talk to the pilot while in flight, asking questions all along the way. Bruce is so knowledgeable about the landscapes we were viewing, offering history, geography, geology, and agricultural tidbits that were both educational and entertaining. There was no problem with him turning the plane for certain photos, and we were lucky enough to get shots of Mt. Waialeale when it was not covered in clouds. At 5,148 feet, this mountain is the wettest spot on the planet, averaging rainfall of 460 inches per year. Waimea Canyon and the NaPali Coast were indescribably beautiful from a bird's-eye view. Because the plane held only 4 persons (including pilot), my husband and I felt like it was our own private tour. It's windy and chilly, though, in the back seat once that window is opened, so be prepared by bringing a scarf for your head and a sweatshirt or jacket (we flew in December). The cost was very reasonable for the one-hour flight ~ and if we have one suggestion, it's that Bruce and Ellen should offer a longer tour. Before we took off, Ellen took our picture by the plane and surprised us when we landed with with a video disc with us on the cover. The video was produced by their son, Carter. So it's truly a family business, and we were happy to support such a venture
.
Great day. Great weather. Great pictures. Great people. So ... DO IT! You won't be disappointed!

Review Title: If you only do one tour - This is it
Review Text:
We booked online. Ellen emailed back a confirm within 24hrs (actually more like 2). Tor from Wings picked us up right outside the cruise terminal and took us to the airport. He gave us so much info on what it is like to live in Hawaii in just the few short minutes of the drive to the airport. Really a tour within a tour! We signed our life away, stepped on the scale - really a formality. Bruce arrived with the last couple he took up, and they were beaming. Tor got us into the plane. Let me tell you, if you have any mobility problems, or if you are a large person, you will be just fine. The plane was easy to get into and we were well taken care of. Probably due to decades as a pilot, Bruce's natural confidence set us at ease right away. He told us what to expect as far as the way the plane moves ahead of time.

It was neat feeling like part of the flight crew. We were able to listen in on the chatter with the tower. And although I did not expect it, both my husband and I felt afterward that there was something really special about taking our tour in an airplane. It's an extra feeling to the tour that is hard to explain, but you will understand it once you go up. Most of our pictures have a bit of the window or the wing in there. And for us, that is just so perfect. We have a remembrance of the phenomenal beauty of Kauai and a reminder of that incredible nostalgic and peaceful feeling of slowly flying over pristine beauty.

Bruce was great at pointing things out - an interactive tour. Really more like a personal conversation between Bruce who knows the Island, it's history, it's ecology and people - and the people lucky enough to get a seat on his plane. We just can't say enough about that - this is a personal tour. Not a prepackaged production. This is one of the few things I'd gladly spend money on again if we are lucky enough to see Hawaii again.

Review Title: Once In A Lifetime Experience... Unbelievable!
Review Text:
My wife and I had the trip of a lifetime with Wings Over Kaua'i on our recent trip to the island. We went to three different islands over the span of 12 days and saw many different things, however, this was the unquestionable highlight of our trip.

The company is a true family affair with Bruce, Ellen and their children, and they made us immediately feel welcome and a part of their extended family.

Bruce is an exceptional pilot and perhaps an even better tour guide. His knowledge of the island -- traditions, culture, geography, etc. -- is made even better by his knowledge of the climate and agriculture that you see during the flight.

We boarded his plane at the Lihu'e airport and took off on a route that followed the Eastern Coast south. We then turned West near Poi'pu and saw many things along the shore. During that part, and the entire trip, Bruce mixed in good conversation with fun facts and information about the island. It was as much of a learning experience as it was a sightseeing tour for us.

He then turned the plane northwest so that we could see the views of Waimea Canyon and eventually the dramatic Napili Coast. Words and photos do not do justice when describing these areas. It is truly an awesome sight and something that is hard to fathom. However, seeing it from the air adds an incredible dimension that you can't tell from land.

Bruce then took us along the Northern Coast of the island and inland to see Wailua Falls and other waterfalls. Again, an awe-inspiring experience.

When we booked the flight, Ellen warned us that the day we were going up could be a bit bumpy because of the tradewinds, but other than a few minor air pockets, it did not bother us at all. The entire flight was very comfortable for both of us.

Bruce also gave us the opportunity to open the window and take photos through that. We were amazed at the photo quality with the window both open and closed.

Overall, you cannot go wrong with booking this flight. It is unquestionable one of the best things I have experienced in our life. The price was very reasonable, and the quality of the experience was second-to-none.

Review Title: The Best Way  to See Kauai
Review Text:
When you get to Kauai you will see all sorts of ads for helicopter rides. I'm sure they're nice, but they are expensive. Wings over Kauai is a ride in a small airplane for about half the price, and it is great, personalized tour for you and your family. The tour takes about 70 minutes. Be sure to bring your camera. (The operator e-mail souvenir pictures and video of your family.)

The owner operator gives you a wonderful guided tour of what may be the most beautiful place in the world. There are scores of waterfalls; misty mountains, green, green valleys; remote, multi-blue beaches; surf and sand; in all a tropical mountain paradise. There is no way you can see all of of Kauai without taking flight, and there is no better way to fly than in a small plane.

Helicoptors rides are cool in themselves, but for this you don't need the distraction of a thrill ride. The plane is simple, smooth and prefect for Kauai. Wings Over Kauai is a family buisness where you will ride with the owner, Bruce, meet his wife, and maybe even one of their kids. It's a warm safe feeling. Bruce is a easy going, knowlegable guide with a gentle sense of humor. He will show and tell everything about Kauai, where the movies were filmed, where the stars live, how agriculture works; he may even tell you the down side of the cost of living or the public schools. And he will show you the tail of Puff the Magic Dragon in the town called Hanelei. I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai.

Review Title: Hate Flying & Heights, But Loved This!
Review Text:
I detest flying and heights, am a "safety nut", and add to all that, I'm cheap, which is why I was so reluctant to book an aerial tour of Kauai. However, I just had to get my eyes on the aerial views I kept seeing pictures of so I took the plunge with Wings Over Kauai. Reasons I chose them over a helicopter ride (and why it was the right choice!):
1. Cheaper---this tour is literally half the cost of a copter ride. The value is unbelievable.
2. Personal---we would have been on the copter with 4 other people plus the pilot. This tour is limited to 3 persons plus Bruce, the pilot, so my husband and I were able to go it alone and have a very tailored, personal experience. Bruce was so knowledgeable about the island and sites he pointed out. We asked lots of questions, and had a wonderful, personal experience.
3. Safety---I kept reading about recent helicopter crashes on aerial tours. WOK has a perfect safety record. I was shocked at how comfortable Bruce made me feel on the fight. I felt completely safe.
4. Stability---the small plane provides a more stable riding experience, and I am really susceptible to motion sickness. Bruce helped me with some "tricks", and I didn't feel badly or get sick the entire flight. I was truly amazed by this.

If you are considering an aerial tour of Kauai (and you should---the views did not disappoint), you should choose WOK. Bruce and Ellen are kind, helpful, considerate, and extremely accommodating.

Thanks a million, Bruce and Ellen!

Review Text:
Please, please do yourself a favor and book a ride with Captain Bruce on Wings Over Kauai Tours! My new husband and I were recently in Kauai for our honeymoon and we knew that we wanted to see Kauai by air. My husband tends to get seasick/airsick/carsick, so I knew I wanted a quiet, uncrowded experience for him. We called on a Tuesday morning to inquire about possible reservations and were able to fly that afternoon!

Here are the POSITIVES:
(1) You get to meet Captain Bruce's wife, Ellen, at the private terminal and learn all about the family (even the kids!). Ladies are presented with a special lei and a flower (which smelled so delicious, I spent the rest of the week trying to track down in perfume form only to find out nobody makes it!). We also met their son, Carter, who was really sweet to us, took photos of us before we got in the airplane and in the airplane, and provided our pre-flight entertainment.
(2) Captain Bruce: Bruce is REALLY nice and knowledgeable; he makes you feel incredibly welcomed and safe. We laughed when he offered us "in flight" service before our flight by giving us each a mint and collecting our wrappers! (They also provide drinks.) My husband got to sit in front with Bruce and do the pre-flight checklist, which made us both feel like we understood the plane better and was really interesting!
(3) You are the only ones on your flight! We were so glad we booked with WOKT after we saw all the noisy helicopters buzz in and out across the way from the private plane terminal, dropping off and picking up hoards of people. Also, other small planes had numerous people on them. On the WOKT plane, only three passengers are allowed at a time, so everyone has a window seat and everyone knows each other.
(4) The flight is not noisy and you get to talk to the pilot whenever you want. There was nice background music in our ear sets, but we were more interested in talking to Bruce about the island.
(5) Flights are affordable and almost custom. We found the WOKT pricing to be extremely reasonable and affordable, especially compared with our experience before with helicopters and other small plane tours. Because Bruce took time to get to know us before and during our flight, he made sure to point out or spend extra time on sights that would be of interest to us. I am a huge fan of the Harrison Ford movie "Six Days, Seven Nights," which was filmed on Kauai, and so is Bruce, so he took special care to point out movie locales for me and we quoted our favorite movie lines. He also dipped in for a closer view of whales breeching and our hotel.

Negatives? Absolutely none! We talked about our flight the rest of the week and the photos we took were the best of our trip. After we got home, there was a nice email for us from Ellen with a photo they took of us before our flight, a great reminder of an awesome time! Thanks Bruce and Ellen!

We took the Pali Mist tour with WOK today (Friday). Making the reservation was very easy. We were concerned about the weather as it has been windy the whole week and my husband was prone to motion sickness. She said that the ride can get bumpy at times and most people were able to tolerate without getting sick.

We hiked a few trials and saw some of the sights earlier during the week and it was really neat to see the same sights from air: the Na Pali coast (via Kalalau trail), the Hanalei bay (via Alaka'i Swamp trail), the Waipo'o falls (via canyon trail). The most amazing was we saw many sights that could only been seen by air. That made the trip really worthwhile. Bruce gave excellent narratives throughout the tour and pointed out the sights for photographs. Overall it was a wonderful trip. I would have given a five-star if the weather were more cooperative. We did not get sick but the flight was bumpy at times due to the wind. I would highly recommend the trip. ** ** Actually we scheduled a one-hour airplane flight -- and followed up with a second one-hour flight several days later.
** ** During our two week vacation we saw and did many things - all where new to us. The WOK flights certainly are extremely high on our list of wonderful experiences. WOK is a first rate & safe operation.
** ** Would we take a third flight with WOK ? YES !!! We highly recommend WOK. But probably a different month so photography conditions (light, clouds, etc) are different -- for us.
** ** Once you have seen Kauai from both the air and from the ground -- -- you will understand why Kauai NEEDS to be seen from the air. Steep mountains limit roads; much of the land probably has never been walked upon - - - it is wilderness, waterfalls, abundant plants and trees, mountains, coast, and ocean waves.

Review Title: Wonderful Welcome to the Garden Isle
Review Text:
I booked Wings Over Kauai after reading several positive reviews and wanting something my entire family, including our infant, could enjoy. I knew I wanted an aerial tour of Kauai, but was as leery of the helicopter tours as they were of my little one. Because we were planning on flying with an infant, I wanted to make sure we wouldn't disturb or ruin anyone else's flight, so I was looking for a tour that was smaller, more personal and unique. With Wings Over Kauai, we got that and more!
When I called to reserve the tour, I spoke with Ellen who was both knowledgeable and VERY friendly. She answered all my questions and was more than willing to work to help accommodate our little one. The plane they fly is a 4-seater, so there wouldn't be anyone else to disturb, and she asked if there was anyplace specific we were looking to fly over so that they could try to work that into the flight plan.
The day of the tour, we showed up early and both Ellen and Bruce (the pilot) greeted us and even presented a gift to our little 'keiki'. When it came time to check-in and go over all of the preflight information, Ellen was helpful and made sure to answer all of our questions and concerns. They even offered us a car seat so that my husband wouldn't have to hold our little one the whole flight, as well as small ear plugs to help with the noise. They also offer a children's-sized headset, but we figured 10 months was a little young to enjoy or even keep it on.
From take-off until landing, the flight was amazing! Bruce was both professional and personable. He explained all of the piloting jargon and information that was passing over the radio, and he also provided a narrative that gave information and details about what we were currently flying over. He did his best to allow me ample opportunity to take photos and also informed me of potential photo ops that would be coming up. Our little one had such a good time that she spent most of the flight laughing, cooing and just enjoying the air from the car seat. My husband enjoyed himself and had a great view even from the rear seat.
One warning for those not used to flying in small aircraft: even on a clear day, it can get a bit bumpy and the nature of the island (mountains and valleys) make for some air pockets. By the end of the flight, my stomach was definitely feeling a bit rough. It had nothing to do with the plane or how it was being piloted, but it is something to keep in mind for those who might not have stomachs of steel. Bruce was very helpful and prepared for any problems - he carried the obligatory air sickness bags but also had ginger candy, water, and a cold cloth that came in VERY handy as we got ready to land.

Overall, I would HIGHLY recommend Wings Over Kauai. Bruce and Ellen were very friendly and the ride itself worth EVERY penny. For both my husband and myself, it was almost half the cost of a helicopter tour, and being able to bring our little one and fly a personal tour made it an even greater value. Anyone looking for a fun and unique way to tour Kauai should definitely consider flying on Wings Over Kauai!

Before leaving the ground, the flight operator/pilot's main focus was safety and comfort. He was well prepared for flight, made everyone feel at ease, and was extremely knowledgeable about the different land forms, mountains, canyons, coastline, different areas/neighborhoods, and yes, even whale watching. His courteous and easy going style made this trip enjoyable, interesting, and fun. What a great experience!!!
Put this one at the top of your list of things to do on Kauai.

Linda & Donovan
New York

Review Title: FANTASTIC!!! Why take a helicopter when you can take Wings Over Kauai?!
Review Text:
WINGS OVER KAUAI: A 70-minute flight around the entire island in a 3-passenger Cessna plane. Owner-operated by Bruce & Ellen Coulombe, this was a wonderful alternative to viewing Kauai from above without being in a helicopter.

We chose Wings Over Kauai because Bruce came highly recommended on numerous trip web sites – and Bruce has a lot of experience – not just flying in general, but specifically flying over Kauai (that was important to us). There was another plane outfit that had 2 pilots – one with a lot of experience flying over Kauai, the other with only about 2 years – and we could not get a guarantee of getting the one with the more experience.

We were so happy we went with Wings Over Kauai!!! Bruce was very professional and we couldn’t have felt safer… he’s a very intelligent & contientious pilot, to be sure!! The plane is a 3-passenger Cessna – which gives everyone a window – and creates for a very tailor-made, personal flight experience!

Another wonderful aspect of going with Wings Over Kauai is the fact that it was about half the price of a helicopter tour, yet just as spectacular…. And I have the photos to prove it!

Review Title: Excellant way to end Anniversary in the Islands!
Review Text: My husband decided at the last minute to book a flight over Kaui while we were in Kona.  THe Blue Shak on Kona booked it for us 2 days before we arrived.  The weather was so clear and even it wasn't raining on the wettest place on earth.  Ellen and Bruce are down to earth folks that truly want to ensure you have the best experience every.  Bruce is an experienced with the plants and fomation of the island.  I felt MUCH safer with his plane that the small helicoptors that kept going in and out of the mountains.  We were able to take a nice photo and I have some clear photos of Mt. Walielie and the water falls and coastlines.  I felt the price was very reasonable for a 70 minute flight.  Please think about using Wings over Kaui for a truly unique experience.  Make sure you battery is charged on your camera and you have PLENTY of space on your memory card if you have a digital camera.. You are going to need it.

Review Title: skip the helicopters: take a Wings Over Kauai flight!
Review Text: We wanted to see Kauai from the air without the rapid motion, daredevil atmosphere, and vertiginous flying patterns used by the many helicopter tour companies. Our innkeeper recommended Bruce and Ellen Coulombe's Wings Over Kauai. Bruce, a very experienced pilot, flies up to three passengers at a time in a small fixed-wing plane. Every attention is paid to safety and comfort. I don't like enclosed spaces and was a bit nervous about the size of the plane, but Bruce's professional and friendly demeanor quickly had me at ease. He is a wonderful narrator as well and the noise-excluding Bose headphones and mics let us speak normally and enjoy his extensive commentary. Ellen runs the reservation desk at the Lihue airport commuter terminal. The Coulombes are delightful, warm, and welcoming people. We were accommodated the same day we called, and had a fantastic flight. Photography was easy and convenient, with great results! We signed up for the 70-minute flight and saw the entire island, including the crater of Mt. Wai'ale'ale, the Na Pali coast, and also the northeastern area, which most aerial tours skip. I highly recommend Wings over Kauai for an enjoyable, safe, and fascinating experience!

Review Title: The only way to really see the island in 70 minutes
Review Text: If you are planning this in your itinerary, note the tour is based at the Lihue (LIH) airport general aviation facilites.  The 70 minute flight ties for the best memory we have of our five days in Kauai (with a catamaran tour of the Na Pali coast).  Two years ago we took a helicopter tour of Maui, and we just feel more comfortable in flying something with wings on it, plus the cost is about one-half of an equally long helicopter flight and covers more of the island.  Bruce, the owner-operator and chief pilot has a prior professional agronomy background (on Kauai).  He was very knowledgeable during his interesting narration of ground features.

Review Text:
We just returned from Kauai, HI and must tell you that the most incredible trip was with Bruce Coulombe and his Cessna 172 plane. First of all I am afraid to fly! This was a hugh event in my 65 years and I must say one of the most exciting. We were seated and given Bose headsets which only let us hear Bruce telling us about the sights and soft Hawaiian music playing in the background. Our photos were excellent. We returned to the ground much too soon for us. It was so peaceful we would have liked it to go on all afternoon!

This is the best way to see Kauai! During our 10 days we traveled around the island and visited all the sites and enjoyed them all but nothing could compare to Wings Over Kauai
